title: Product Manager - AI Platform
description:
**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
As a Product Manager (level to be determined by experience) for the Data Solutions business, you will own the technical direction of Data Solutions on Precisely’s AI Studio, and support contribute to the overall Data API, Cloud and SaaS strategy. You will set the roadmap and drive the engineering understanding of the backlog for Precisely’s hosted MCP Server, Skills, Agents and Apps. Additionally, you will assist with technical requirements, development resources and documentation for Precisely Data APIs. This is a hands-on, technical role at the intersection of Product Management and Engineering: you will become the subject matter expert on our technology, define acceptance criteria, consult on sprint priorities, resolve customer escalations, and make the daily calls that keep multiple engineering teams delivering results. You will partner closely with customers, support, QA, and the broader Product team to create Data Solutions for real-world addressing business challenges.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Be the technically oriented subject matter expert for all Data Solutions and content on AI Studio, the modern developer portal
* Serve as a subject matter expert on AI integration with Precisely Data focusing on APIs, MCP Server, Skills, Agents and Apps
* Use AI tools to build and test prototype solutions to prioritized business problems
* Work closely with Sales Engineers to validate proposed solutions for field verified use cases
* Create detailed engineering requirements to convert prototypes into hardened products
* Perform industry and market research to stay informed of technological advancements in AI to identify revenue opportunity and to apply best practices to Precisely solutions
* Own and prioritize the backlog across multiple engineering teams, covering new features, enhancements to existing features. You will assist and advise the engineering team on their defects and technical debt considerations.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the support team as they handle customer escalations, this could be from initial triage on accounts through to engineering root-cause analysis, fix validation, and customer-facing resolution.
* Act as the technical bridge between Product, Engineering, QA, Support, and external customers – running weekly review calls and contributing to solution definition reviews.
* Advise on communications, release-notes and other documentation.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Atleast 5 years of professional experience in a technical role (software development, solutions engineering, data analytics, QA, or similar) or a recent college graduate with a degree in Artificial Intelligence or a related technical field
* Strong foundational knowledge of AI tools, integrations, and the modern AI ecosystem — including LLMs, AI agents, MCP servers, and API-based developer tooling
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to build, test, or evaluate solutions — whether through coursework, personal projects, internships, or work experience
* Ability to read and understand REST API documentation, basic software architecture concepts, and technical design discussions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable translating technical concepts for both engineering and business audiences
* Demonstrated curiosity and self-driven learning in the AI/ML space
* Some international travel maybe required.

**AI/Skills Knowledge**

* Coursework, certifications, or hands-on project experience with AI/ML technologies, prompt engineering, or agent-based architecture
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate work — drafting requirements, reviewing code, testing outputs, or prototyping solutions
* Familiarity with concepts such as MCP servers, AI agents, skills/apps frameworks, or LLM APIs is a strong differentiator

**Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)**

* Internship or project experience in product management, business analysis, or solution engineering
* Experience working with GraphQL APIs — querying, schema exploration, or integration testing
* Exposure to location data, address geocoding, GIS, or data quality concepts
* Experience with hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or API marketplace ecosystems
* Understanding of how agent-native API architectures affect product and developer experience

**Application and Interview Impersonation Notice:**
Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated (“Precisely”) is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators.
  
  
The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
We are hiring a Salesforce Revenue Cloud Product Manager, a technical lead, to drive innovative solutions for revenue management and business growth. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud, with hands-on experience in CPQ, pricing, product catalog, orders, and contracts. The ideal candidate will lead technical design, implementation, and optimization of Salesforce solutions, ensuring scalability and alignment with business objectives.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design and implement Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions, including CPQ, pricing, and contract management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver tailored solutions.
* Optimize Sales Cloud and Service Cloud functionalities to enhance customer experience and sales efficiency.
* Lead technical workshops, solution architecture, and integration efforts.
* Ensure system scalability, security, and performance through best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align quoting solutions with business objectives.
* Manage the lifecycle of cloud-based applications, from ideation to deployment and maintenance.
* Drive initiatives to optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability.
* Stay updated on emerging cloud technologies and trends to maintain competitive advantage.
* Lead the integration and enhancement of applications connected to Nokia’s next-generation CRM (ngCRM) platform. Ensure seamless interoperability between ngCRM and other service-related applications. Identify opportunities to improve user experience and operational efficiency across connected systems.
* Oversee the successful delivery of programs and projects within scope, budget, and timeline. Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track program success. Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure smooth execution.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline with 8-10 years working on cloud SW products and leading teams in different roles
* Effective communication skills and flexibility to closely collaborate with international partners and colleagues , Lead product delivery
* Experience in people management and leading internal and external teams
* Proven experience in Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud. (Salesforce products)
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

**Nice-to-have:**

* Salesforce knowledge (or even certification), Data engineering experience
* Strong knowledge of CPQ, product catalog, pricing, orders, and contracts.

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Senior Project and Release Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex digital and eCommerce projects while providing strong release management leadership across the software delivery lifecycle. This role combines project delivery excellence with technical release governance, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and deployed safely through development, test, pre-production and production environments. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, DevOps, infrastructure and third-party partners to drive high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement. Based on the uploaded job descriptions.

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex projects and programmes using Agile, Hybrid or Waterfall methodologies.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks and dependencies.
* Build strong relationships with clients, stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Provide clear reporting on project performance, milestones and delivery risks.
* Own release planning, scheduling and governance across multiple environments.
* Coordinate deployments and ensure release readiness across business and technical teams.
* Manage release risks, dependencies and communications.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, DevOps and Infrastructure teams to support efficient and reliable releases.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery, release and deployment processes.
* Support post-release reviews and implementation of lessons learned.

What we want from you
  
  

* Proven experience managing software delivery projects within Agile environments.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and release management practices.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes and release governance.
* Ability to engage confidently with technical teams on topics such as environments, branching strategies, deployments and release risk.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and leadership skills.
* Strong planning, organisational and financial management capabilities.
* Experience within digital and eCommerce environments is essential.

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: Academic Operations
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on academic leader to partner with the Chief Academic Officer in building the next generation of online higher education.

The General Manager – Academic Excellence & Innovation will be responsible for driving academic innovation, curriculum modernization, academic product development, learning experience design, academic quality frameworks, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and strategic academic transformation across our university partnerships.

This is
**not**
a traditional Academic Operations role. Operational delivery, learner progression, and student success functions are managed through dedicated teams. This role is focused on
**building**
,
**innovating**
, and
**transforming**
the academic ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong academic foundations with product thinking, learner-centric design, technology orientation, and a deep understanding of the Indian Online Higher Education ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Academic Product & Portfolio Development

* Lead the design and development of innovative academic products, online degree programmes, certificate programmes, industry pathways, and stackable learning offerings.
* Identify emerging learner and industry needs to build future-ready academic portfolios.
* Support enterprise learning and university partnership opportunities through academic solution design.
* Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify new programme opportunities.

Curriculum Innovation

* Drive curriculum modernization across degree and certificate programmes.
* Develop competency-based, industry-integrated and AI-enabled curriculum frameworks.
* Design learner-centric academic pathways aligned with employability and lifelong learning.
* Collaborate with universities, faculty and industry experts to continuously enhance programme relevance.

Learning Experience & Innovation

* Design differentiated digital learning experiences that improve learner engagement and academic outcomes.
* Partner with Learning Technology teams to shape future learner journeys.
* Recommend innovative pedagogical models, assessment approaches and learner engagement strategies.
* Support the adoption of AI-enabled learning experiences and digital innovation.

Academic Excellence & Governance

* Develop academic quality frameworks and continuous improvement models.
* Establish academic policies, governance frameworks and quality standards across programmes.
* Support academic reviews, programme audits and institutional quality initiatives.
* Ensure academic innovations remain aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Strategic Academic Transformation

* Lead institution-wide academic transformation initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional projects involving Academic Operations, Student Success, Learning Technology, Career Services and partner universities.
* Support new university onboarding and strategic academic initiatives.
* Act as a strategic advisor to the Chief Academic Officer on future academic models.

AI & Future Learning

* Evaluate emerging trends in higher education, AI and digital learning.
* Drive experimentation around AI-enabled teaching, learning and learner support.
* Support the evolution of intelligent learning ecosystems and future-ready academic models.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, you will:

* Launch innovative academic products and learner pathways.
* Modernize curriculum frameworks across key programmes.
* Improve learner experience through innovative academic design.
* Institutionalize academic quality and governance frameworks.
* Drive AI-enabled learning initiatives.
* Support strategic university partnerships and new programme launches.
* Become a trusted strategic partner to the Chief Academic Officer.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for professionals who have built or transformed academic ecosystems within
**Online Higher Education**
or
**Higher Education-focused EdTech organizations**
.

The ideal candidate is:

* A builder rather than a maintainer.
* Hands-on and execution-oriented.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating new solutions.
* Passionate about learner experience and academic innovation.
* Equally comfortable working with curriculum, technology, universities, and business stakeholders.
* Able to move seamlessly between strategy and execution.

Mandatory Experience

* 12–18 years of experience in Online Higher Education, OPMs, Higher Education-focused EdTech or Digital Learning organizations.
* Demonstrated experience in academic product development, curriculum innovation, learning experience design, or academic transformation.
* Experience working with universities, academic leadership and cross-functional business teams.
* Strong understanding of the
  **Indian Online Higher Education ecosystem**
  .

Essential Knowledge

Candidates should have practical experience and understanding of:

* UGC Online & ODL Regulations
* UGC-DEB regulatory framework
* National Education Policy (NEP 2020)
* Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)
* National Credit Framework (NCrF)
* Online Degree programme design and delivery
* Academic governance within Indian Higher Education
* Industry-integrated curriculum design
* Higher Education quality frameworks

description:
Location: Noida, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Establish delivery discipline: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.

title: Release, Delivery & Scrum Lead
description:
**About Sightview**
Sightview Software LLC provides a suite of industry-leading software specifically geared toward ophthalmology and optometry practices — practice management, surgical, revenue cycle management (RCM), MIPS reporting, and more. Sightview is a one-stop shop for eye care specialists and their patients.
  
  
**Engagement**

* Integrity
* Collaboration
* Resilience
* Accountability

**Job Summary**
The Release & Delivery Lead is the single accountable owner of how Sightview ships. This role owns the release calendar and Change Control Board process end-to-end, defines and enforces the checkpoints before, during, and after every deployment, and keeps internal teams and customer-facing stakeholders informed of what’s coming, when, and what it means for them. The Release & Delivery Lead also serves as Scrum Master for one or more delivery teams, bringing agile discipline to planning and execution, and partners closely with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support to protect the reliability of every release our customers depend on for patient care.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
**Release Coordination**

* Own the release calendar for our products and coordinate scope, timing, and readiness with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Support.
* Run the Change Control Board (CCB) process, gather decision evidence, and coach the organization on the process elements.
* Facilitate release readiness (go/no-go) reviews and bring the right people together to assess tradeoffs and reach go/no-go decisions based on clear entry/exit criteria.
* Track release scope in Jira (fix versions, release tickets, dependencies) and keep status visible to stakeholders.
* Identify and track release risks, dependencies, and blockers early, and drive them to resolution or escalation in partnership with stakeholders.

**Deployment Process and Checkpoints**

* Document and maintain the pre-, intra-, and post-deployment processes, checklists, and runbooks in Confluence.
* Define clear checkpoints and owners for each phase: code freeze, regression sign-off, change approval, deployment window, smoke testing, rollback decision, and post-release validation.
* Coordinate live deployment events and act as the single point of coordination while a release is in flight.
* Lead post-release reviews and retrospectives, capture lessons learned, and turn them into process improvements.
* Keep release documentation audit-ready for regulated and compliance-driven reviews.

**Agile Delivery**

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more teams: facilitate planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum and Agile practices, and remove impediments to delivery.
* Help plan and align work across teams (PI Planning or equivalent) and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Track and report delivery metrics such as velocity, predictability, cycle time, release frequency, and escaped defects.

**Communication**

* Own internal release communications: release plans, deployment notices, status updates, and outage or maintenance notices.
* Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Marketing on customer-facing communications, including release notes, maintenance windows, and feature announcements.
* Keep Support and customer-facing teams ready for each release with known issues, changes that affect workflows, and FAQs.
* Give leadership concise, reliable updates on release health and delivery status.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in software delivery, release management, or agile project delivery.
* 3+ years as a Scrum Master on software development teams.
* A proven record of coordinating production releases across several teams and functions.
* Experience writing and maintaining process documentation, runbooks, and checklists.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write a clear deployment notice for engineers and a plain-language release summary for customers or executives.
* Hands-on experience with Jira (boards, fix versions, filters/JQL, dashboards) and Confluence.
* Daily fluency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Comfort facilitating meetings with a wide range of people, from engineers to executives to customers.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle several release trains and deadlines.
* Enough technical grounding to follow deployment pipelines, environments, and release risks, and to ask engineers the right questions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) in SAFe, or leading releases across several Scrum teams (Scrum of Scrums).
* Certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), PSM, CSM, or ITIL 4 Foundation.
* A technical background, such as prior work as a developer, QA engineer, systems administrator, or DevOps engineer.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), environment management, and rollback strategies.
* Health IT experience, especially EHR/EMR, practice management, or other clinical software.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and customer-facing maintenance windows.
* Experience in regulated environments, such as HIPAA, ONC Health IT Certification, or SOC 2.
* Experience with ITSM or change management practices (CAB, change records, release approvals).
* Experience working alongside a support organization (for example HubSpot or Zendesk) to connect releases with customer issues.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Regular use of a keyboard, mouse, and monitor, requiring repetitive hand and wrist motion
* Ability to communicate clearly by phone, video conference, and in person
* Ability to read and interpret information on a computer screen and in printed documents
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching within a home or office environment
* Ability to occasionally lift and move office supplies or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation for this role is paid in local currency and will be confirmed based on experience, qualifications, and location. [Benefits package to be confirmed — this role is based in India or the Philippines and is expected to be administered through Sightview’s local employer-of-record provider rather than Sightview’s U.S. benefits plans; do not default to the U.S. medical/dental/vision/401(k) package used on domestic JDs.]
  
  
**BACKGROUND CHECK & DRUG-FREE WORKPLACE**
[Confirm background-check and any drug-testing requirements with local counsel or Sightview’s employer-of-record provider before posting — the standard U.S. paragraph used on domestic JDs, including the marijuana-testing carve-out, may not apply or be appropriate for a role based in India or the Philippines.]
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Sightview is an equal opportunity employer and recruits, hires, trains, and promotes without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law in the country where this role is based. [Confirm the specific protected-characteristic language applicable under India/Philippines law with local counsel before posting — the U.S. Title VII/ADA-style list used on domestic JDs does not map directly to either jurisdiction.]

title: Lead Data Implementation Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you.
**#UatInsurity**

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year.

* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.

**Insurity’s Next**

Insurity's next Data Implementation Specialist will be highly analytical and detail-oriented, comfortable leading others, strong with customers and stakeholders, process and improvement-minded, self-directed and adaptable, and credible as a subject matter expert. This role leads complex Rates data implementation work, translating regulatory updates and business requirements into accurate, timely production outcomes.
  
  
A good role for a technically strong, organized, customer-savvy individual who likes ownership, solving complex problems, and helping others succeed.

* Lead the analysis, implementation, and quality review of complex Rates updates while providing direction, coaching, and issue resolution support to team members and stakeholders.
* Develop and translate Rate and Forms Table updates.
* Collaborate with team members to determine business requirements including analyzing circulars to determine system impact.
* Participate in business requirement walkthroughs and specification inspections.
* Maintain and improve Rates, Forms manuals/documents.
* Develop trusted relationships with internal and external customers.
* Provide leadership on large/complex development/bureau projects.
* Work with Line of Business Manager, Project Manager, Customer Success Manager, etc. on issue resolution for project and/or the customer account issues.
* Conduct complex root cause analysis on Rates and Forms data entry issues and identify and implement work quality improvements.
* Suggest new tools or workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Utilize effective methods and techniques to satisfy quality and timeliness commitments.
* Analyze problem requests and data entry issues reported by customers and process corrections
* Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to team members and off-shore Rates and Forms Implementation Specialists.
* Lead the planning, organization, and coordination of team member activities by estimating scope of assignments and developing work schedules and project plans.
* Act as Rates and Forms Subject Matter Expert for training and product expertise, including formal presentations as requested.
* Work directly with internal & external customers to identify and resolve problems during testing.
* Lead or provide direction in special projects as assigned.
* Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including reading relevant publications, articles, blogs, etc.
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For**
Demonstrated these skills at an expert level:
  
  

* Analytical and critical thinking
* Written and oral English communication
* Time management including work planning, prioritization, and organization
* Ability to handle multiple priorities or tasks
* Self-starter and quick learner
* Detail-oriented
* Active listener
* Ability to collaborate and work autonomously
* Flexible and adaptable
* Lead coaching, training and mentoring
* Ability to articulately present information
* Meeting facilitation
* Ability to work effectively with executive stakeholders
* Recommended 4 years of experience in fast-paced, customer driven environment
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in related field
* Travel required: Up to 10%

Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

title: Product Engineer – AI-Driven Analog Chip Design
description:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
We are looking for experienced Product Engineers to join our growing team in Santa Clara, California and help define the next generation of AI-driven technology for analog and custom IC design.
  
  
**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do.
  
  
We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:

+ Analog and custom IC design
+ Standard cell design and optimization
+ Physical implementation
+ Design migration and design reuse
+ Semiconductor design automation
+ Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows

* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.
  
  
This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
  
  
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

description:

**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.

* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on expertise in policy administration data migration, including Conversion strategy and execution planning, Data quality frameworks, audit controls, and governance practices
* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Good understanding of SQL, stored procedures, and ETL frameworks, with the ability to support data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting in large-scale migration programs.

title: New Product Development Manager(Beauty)
description:
**Role Summary**

Yes Madam is looking for an agile, hands-on
**Manager – Research & New Product Development (R&D / NPD)**
to lead the end-to-end formulation research, lab bench testing, and nationwide service deployment of premium at-home salon treatments. This role bridges international skincare innovations (specifically K-Beauty layered hydration and J-Beauty precision techniques) with cosmetic chemistry, rigorous stability/efficacy testing, and scalable field execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **R&D Formulation & Bench Testing:**
  Direct cosmetic research and evaluate bench samples, pilot batches, and raw materials alongside internal labs and external third-party manufacturers. Assess formula stability, pH levels, active delivery, texture/slip, fragrance longevity, and patch/irritation safety under in-home usage conditions.
* **Global Trend Intelligence & Adaptation:**
  Track international clinical advances, DTC trends, and salon breakthroughs across South Korea, Japan, and Western markets. Adapt emergent ingredients (actives, barrier-repair lipids, peptides, botanical ferments) for Indian skin profiles.
* **Treatment Architecture & SOPs:**
  Engineer end-to-end service protocols for specialized facials, cleanups, manicures, and pedicures. Draft clinical SOPs, active ingredient dosage charts, contraindication matrices, and pre/post-care regimens.
* **Sensory & Blinded Efficacy Trials:**
  Design structured sensory mapping and efficacy trials across diverse skin types to benchmark product performance, ease of removal, and skin tolerance against market leaders.
* **Beautician Training & Video Enablement:**
  Conduct hands-on masterclasses and evaluate technician fidelity on signature massage techniques and aesthetic tools (LED, ultrasonic, cryo globes). Direct and film step-by-step digital training modules and quick-reference cards.
* **Cross-Functional Commercialization:**
  Collaborate with Brand Marketing, Regulatory QA, and Supply Chain to seamlessly pilot, scale, and iterate on treatments based on field quality metrics and customer feedback.

**Core Competencies**

* **Cosmetic Science & Formulation:**
  Deep understanding of cosmetic chemistry, ingredient compatibility (AHAs/BHAs, Retinol, Vitamin C, Peptides, Niacinamide), stability/preservative testing, and raw material sourcing.
* **Skincare & Facial Therapy:**
  Multi-step K-Beauty glass-skin hydration, J-Beauty lymphatic drainage/facial contouring, and advanced peel/exfoliation handling.
* **Hand, Foot & Tool Care:**
  Manicure/pedicure formulations (masks, chemical peels, cuticles, body butters), medical-grade sanitation, and modern handheld salon tools.
* **Documentation & Training:**
  SOP authoring, clinical safety frameworks, on-camera technical demonstration, and field-force upskilling.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Degree/Diploma in Cosmetic Technology, Formulation Science, Cosmetology, Beauty Therapy (CIDESCO / CIBTAC or equivalent), or related aesthetic/dermatological disciplines.
* **Experience:**
  4–7+ years of hands-on experience spanning skincare formulation/testing, salon service development, and beautician training.
* **Skills:**
  Strong bilingual communication (English & Hindi) with the ability to translate scientific concepts into simple operational workflows.

title: Lead Engineer - Systems Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: SAP CCM - Condition Contract Management
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP CCM**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

title: Digital Strategist
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
As a Digital Strategist, you will sit across from Fortune 500 clients, understand their business problem, recommend the right use cases to make best use of the client’s investments in Adobe Experience Cloud solution, and own the delivery outcome. This is a consulting and advisory seat distinct from a pure implementation role.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
**Adobe Experience Cloud & Digital Ecosystem**

* Advise clients on the right Adobe Experience Cloud solution mix — Analytics, Target, Campaign, AEP, CJA, AJO, AEM — against their business objectives.
* Own delivery outcomes on Adobe tools: configure, design, and lead the strategy layer, not just execute downstream tasks.
* Contextualise Adobe data and outputs within a broader full-funnel digital strategy spanning paid, owned, and earned channels.

**Client Advisory & Consulting**

* Lead discovery sessions and requirement-gathering conversations with client stakeholders, including CXO-level audiences.
* Translate complex business problems into clear, recommendation-led digital strategy and Adobe DX roadmaps.
* Own the client outcome — from requirements to recommendation to delivery — with accountability for measurable business results.
* Manage senior client relationships and present strategy confidently to Fortune 500 leadership.

**AI-Native Consulting & Innovation**

* Drive adoption of AI-enabled consulting methodologies — personalization, segmentation, journey orchestration, content optimization, and operational efficiency.
* Identify where AI can improve client outcomes, including emerging practices such as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).
* Build or contribute to reusable AI-enabled consulting assets — frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks — applied across engagements.

**Industry & Strategic Depth**

* Bring demonstrable depth in at least one priority vertical — retail / e-commerce, BFSI, travel & hospitality, or media & entertainment.
* Use industry-specific KPIs and dynamics to ground recommendations in real business context.
* Develop comprehensive, multi-channel digital marketing strategies that go beyond single-tool specialism.

What we want from you
  
  

* Experience: Min8+ years of total work experience, with at least 50% in digital strategy, digital marketing management, or Adobe DX advisory. Recent relevant experience (last 3 years) is weighted heavily.
* Adobe / DX fluency: Hands-on ownership of at least one Adobe Experience Cloud tool with named outcomes
* Client advisory: Proven ability to advise clients, gather requirements, recommend solutions, and own delivery outcomes — not just implement or report.
* Digital marketing breadth: Working command across multiple disciplines — SEO, SEM, paid social, email/lifecycle, marketing automation, analytics — enough to give holistic cross-channel recommendations.
* Industry depth: Sustained engagement in at least one priority vertical where the industry’s specific dynamics genuinely informed the work.
* AI engagement: Demonstrated application of AI-enabled tools or methodologies to client or marketing problems, beyond personal productivity use.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Full-time MBA strongly preferred as a proxy for structured thinking, communication, and stakeholder navigation.
* Enterprise exposure: Experience operating at, or delivering to, enterprise-scale environments comparable to Fortune 500 client engagements.

If you know some of this even better
  
  

* Adobe Experience Cloud certifications (AEP, Analytics, Target, CJA, AJO).
* Prior employment at Adobe, or within the Adobe partner ecosystem, materially reducing ramp time.
* Depth across two or more priority verticals.
* Named AI consulting deliverables — a GenAI personalization framework, agentic workflow, or GEO/AEO strategy with measurable outcomes.

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
  
  
We lead with
**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead

Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders

**The role:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

Find the problems that matter

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

Support the founders

* Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
* Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.

**You must have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
* Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
* A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
* Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
* Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
* Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.

**Good to have**

* Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

to help us build NamiNaya from the ground up.

You'll work directly with leadership on fashion collections, brand positioning, sourcing, product development, creative campaigns, partnerships, e-commerce, and business growth.

• Help conceptualize NamiNaya's first women's clothing collections.

**📌 Fashion Brand Building & E-Commerce**

**📌 Business Development & Partnerships**

**📌 Execution & Special Projects**

• Work directly with leadership to turn fashion and business ideas into actionable projects.

• Coordinate with designers, suppliers, creative teams, and external partners.

• Track product development, sourcing, project timelines, and launch milestones.

• Prepare market research, competitor analysis, business presentations, and execution plans.

⭐ Success in This Role

You'll be successful if:

✅ You bring original fashion and business ideas, not just inspiration from social media.

✅ You recognize emerging fashion trends and can explain their commercial potential.

✅ You can help transform clothing concepts into real products through designers and manufacturers.

✅ You understand how fashion, branding, pricing, marketing, and customer experience work together.

✅ You contribute to building NamiNaya Store into an attractive fashion shopping destination.

✅ You help develop campaigns and growth opportunities for NamiNaya Studio.

✅ You demonstrate initiative, accountability, creativity, and strong execution.

👤 What We're Looking For

**.**

🎓 Education & Requirements

title: Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, data-driven, and execution-focused Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and continuous evolution of Mirchi Digital's consumer-facing digital products. The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking, strong product intuition, technical understanding, and a customer-first mindset to build scalable, intuitive, and engaging digital experiences.

This role will involve end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap, from identifying customer needs and defining opportunities to collaborating with cross-functional teams, launching features, and driving measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
* Identify new product opportunities through market research, competitive benchmarking, customer insights, and data analysis.
* Translate business objectives into clear product requirements, feature priorities, and actionable development plans.
* Define and track product KPIs related to user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.

**2. Product Development & Execution**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and conceptualization to development, launch, and optimization.
* Work closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and business teams to deliver high-quality product experiences.
* Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, and user journeys.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, prioritization, and release timelines using Agile/Lean methodologies.
* Identify dependencies, manage risks, and proactively resolve execution challenges to ensure timely delivery.

**3. User Experience & Customer Engagement**

* Champion a customer-first approach across product planning and decision-making.
* Collaborate with UI/UX teams to create intuitive, seamless, and engaging experiences across mobile applications and web platforms.
* Analyze user behavior, customer journeys, conversion funnels, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Drive initiatives focused on improving user engagement, customer satisfaction, retention, and overall product experience.

**4. Analytics, Growth & Optimization**

* Leverage product analytics and customer insights to make informed decisions and measure feature performance.
* Design and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments to continuously improve user experience and business metrics.
* Monitor critical metrics such as DAU/MAU, conversion rates, feature adoption, churn, and retention.
* Partner with growth and marketing teams to optimize user acquisition, onboarding, and activation journeys.
* Develop a strong understanding of digital growth channels, including App Store Optimization (ASO) and organic discovery.

**5. Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the central point of ownership for assigned products and initiatives.
* Communicate product priorities, progress, outcomes, and challenges effectively to key stakeholders.
* Influence cross-functional teams through clear thinking, data-backed recommendations, and strong collaboration.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and technical feasibility to deliver maximum product impact.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5-10 years of relevant Product Management experience, preferably building and scaling B2C digital products.
* An MBA from a Tier 1 institution. Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of the digital consumer ecosystem; experience in OTT, music streaming, entertainment, media, or subscription-led platforms will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Agile product development, sprint management, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional execution.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product decisions.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, Balsamiq, or equivalent product analytics and design tools.
* Working knowledge of APIs, mobile and web technologies, experimentation frameworks, and product performance monitoring.

**Key Competencies**

* **Product Ownership:**
  Strong accountability for product decisions, execution, and measurable outcomes.
* **Customer Obsession:**
  Deep understanding of customer needs, behavior, and pain points.
* **Analytical Thinking:**
  Ability to make structured, data-informed decisions.
* **Innovation Mindset:**
  Curiosity to explore emerging technologies, trends, and product opportunities.
* **Technical Acumen:**
  Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand technical trade-offs.
* **Execution Excellence:**
  Ability to prioritize effectively, solve problems, and consistently deliver results.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills.

**What We're Looking For**

Someone who doesn't just manage features but thinks like a product owner, acts like a problem-solver, and delivers like an entrepreneur.

A professional who is equally comfortable discussing customer experiences, analyzing conversion funnels, defining product strategy, and working alongside engineers to bring impactful products to market.
