title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Principal Product Manager - Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences
  
  
Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.
  
  
The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.
  
  
This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.
  
  
What You Will Own
  
  
**The current data experiences.**
Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.
  
  
**The reliability and alerting surface.**
Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.
  
  
**The agentic investigation experience.**
You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  

* Set the multi-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against.
* Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces.
* Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI-assisted experiences.
* Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on.
* Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals.
* Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.
* Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
* Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost.
* Create leadership-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring
  
  

* 8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.
* Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.
* Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.
* A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.
* Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.
* Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.
* Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.
* High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface.

Must-Have Qualities
  
  

* Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.
* Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering.
* Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on.
* Governance-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product.
* Sets direction. Defines a vision for a broad area and rallies teams around it.
* Analytical. Uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine decisions.
* High drive and ownership. Pushes through ambiguity across a large surface and drives execution to conclusion.
* Tradeoff thinker. Frames options and recommendations clearly for leadership.

**About Us**
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. title: Director- Revenue Operations & Intelligence
description:
**About the company**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance.

The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization.

This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical
specialists to implement scalable improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Executive Revenue Intelligence**

* Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth.
* Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms.
* Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards.

**2. Commercial Performance & Predictability**

* Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk.
* Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams.
* Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability.

**3. Revenue Operating Model**

* Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures.
* Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle.
* Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model.

**4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment**

* Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness.
* Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights.
* Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights
  **.**

**5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance**

* Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth.
* Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption.
* Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements.
* Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements.

**6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI**

* Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness.
* Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes.
* Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists.
* Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools.
* Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce for Revenue Operations, including governance, data quality, workflows, adoption, and integrations.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools such as Power BI.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, defining business metrics, and
  translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Alliances, and other stakeholders around shared commercial outcomes.
* Strong process design, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience in technology services, SaaS, consulting, cloud, AI, digital engineering, or another complex B2B environment.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Amplemarket.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or equivalent platforms to improve analysis, workflows, data quality, or decision support.
* Exposure to SQL, data modeling, advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled decision support.
* Ability to learn adjacent GTM platforms and technologies quickly.

**Desired Attributes**

* A strategic thinker who remains grounded in data and measurable business outcomes.
* Intellectually curious, independent in judgment, and commercially pragmatic.
* Able to simplify complex business questions and communicate a clear point of view.
* Constructively challenges inconsistent information and unsupported assumptions.
* Comfortable working directly with senior executives and functional leaders.
* Strong at distinguishing between commercial, process, data, and technology issues.
* Highly structured, proactive, and disciplined in prioritization and follow-through.
* A collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a great personality.

title: Senior Manager E-commerce & Marketplaces
description:
Pegasus, part of the B. Jain Group, is an established children’s publishing brand with a wide portfolio of books, educational products and screen-free learning experiences.

With an established presence across Amazon India, leading online marketplaces and our own D2C website, we are looking for a capable e-commerce leader to strengthen our online business and drive its next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and people-oriented
**Senior Manager – E-commerce &**

**Online Sales**
to lead our existing team of performance marketing, marketplace and cataloging professionals.

The role requires someone with a strong understanding of how e-commerce businesses operate, from product visibility and online merchandising to advertising effectiveness, sales conversion and profitability.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting direction, developing the team, reviewing performance and ensuring that our products achieve their full sales potential across online channels.

**This is a business management and team leadership role, rather than a hands-on advertising or catalog execution position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Commercial Ownership**

* Take ownership of overall online sales performance, revenue targets and profitability.
* Develop channel-wise and product-wise growth strategies across Amazon India, other marketplaces and the Pegasus website.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, organic visibility, market share and contribution margins.
* Ensure that advertising expenditure and operational costs are aligned with commercial objectives.
* Drive sustainable business growth through effective planning, prioritization and execution.

**2. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and develop an existing team of performance marketers, marketplace specialists and cataloging professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, measurable KPIs and accountability across functions.
* Review individual and team performance, provide direction and ensure timely execution.
* Coach team members, resolve operational challenges and build a collaborative, high-performance culture.
* Assess resource requirements, identify capability gaps and improve team productivity.

**3. Performance Marketing & Marketplace Management**

* Provide strategic and technical direction to specialists managing Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate advertising strategies, campaign structure, budgets and effectiveness.
* Monitor ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates and overall advertising efficiency.
* Ensure continuous optimization of advertising spends while balancing revenue growth and profitability.
* Guide the team in improving product visibility, organic rankings and marketplace sales performance.

**4. Product Performance & Online Merchandising**

* Ensure effective listing, positioning and presentation of products across all relevant online channels.
* Oversee catalog quality, content, keywords, images, A+ content, pricing and promotional strategies.
* Monitor product-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve discoverability and conversions.
* Plan and oversee successful launches of new books, series and product categories.
* Coordinate with editorial, product development, marketing, design and inventory teams to ensure products are online-ready and commercially supported.
* Ensure systematic attention to both bestselling and underperforming products.

**5. Performance Reviews & Business Analytics**

* Establish robust reporting and review processes covering sales, advertising, catalog quality and profitability.
* Analyze channel-wise and product-wise performance to identify commercial opportunities and execution gaps.
* Conduct structured reviews with team members and ensure follow-through on agreed actions.
* Prepare monthly business reviews and actionable growth plans for management.
* Take responsibility for achieving agreed targets within approved budgets.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce or online retail.
* Proven experience managing and developing teams handling marketplaces, performance marketing or digital commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon India, including marketplace advertising, catalog management and sales optimization.
* Good understanding of D2C performance marketing, particularly Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Experience managing advertising budgets, sales targets and business performance.
* Strong understanding of online merchandising, product discoverability, conversion optimization and marketplace operations.
* Sound commercial judgment with the ability to balance growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical, communication, people management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to guide technical specialists, hold teams accountable and deliver measurable business results.

Experience in consumer products, books, toys, educational products, stationery, baby products or similar categories would be an advantage.

**Why Join Pegasus?**

* Lead an established online business with significant growth opportunities.
* Manage an existing team of specialists rather than build operations from scratch.
* Take meaningful ownership of commercial strategy, team performance and business growth.
* Work closely with senior leadership in a growing Indian consumer brand.
* Opportunity to build a scalable and high-performing e-commerce function.

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349

Job responsibilities

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

description:

title: Product Manager – DEX & Automations
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
  
  
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.
  
  
You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and GTM teams, you will define clear requirements, deliver iterative value, and create measurable outcomes for both IT administrators and the employees they support.
  
  
DEX Monitoring & Insights
  
  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for real-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user-centric performance during live usage.
* Drive the development of AI-powered insights that transform raw telemetry into normalized, actionable intelligence — enabling IT teams to detect, investigate, and remediate issues before employees are impacted.
* Own the Tia Reporting capability, enabling self-service conversational reporting and dynamic dashboards that replace static analytics with real-time, natural-language-driven insights.
* Expand DEX visibility beyond the desktop by leading the strategy for DEX for Mobile (Android and iOS), Exoprise integration for network and SaaS performance monitoring, and future endpoint architecture investments.
* Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.

**Automations & Workflow Orchestration**

* Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
* Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
* Define the end-to-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise-scale operations.
* Collaborate with Engineering and UX to design automation creation workflows that are accessible to IT generalists while remaining expressive enough for advanced users and MSPs.
* Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.

**Cross-Functional & Strategic**

* Act as the product domain authority for DEX & Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well-scoped requirements.
* Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
* Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
* Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.

**Requirements**
**Must Have**

* 4+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
* Demonstrated experience owning complex, data-intensive product areas with strong analytical ability — comfort with telemetry, metrics-driven roadmapping, and outcome-based KPIs.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into well-defined product requirements and ship iterative value in an agile environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without authority and align cross-functional stakeholders from Engineering to Executive leadership.
* Experience working in or alongside GTM, Sales, or Customer Success functions, with the ability to create compelling product positioning and enablement content.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Hands-on familiarity with DEX platforms (e.g. 1E, Nexthink, Riverbed Aternity) or IT automation tools (e.g. Ansible, PowerShell DSC, ServiceNow Orchestration).
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, GenAI for scripting or remediation.
* Experience in or exposure to the Gartner DEX Management Tools, UEM, or AEM market categories.
* Scripting literacy in PowerShell, Bash, or Python — not a hard requirement, but enables faster domain depth and more productive engineering partnerships.
* Fluency in German is a plus given the Munich location and regional customer base.

We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. title: Senior Product Discovery Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager, Discovery**
( VZY)

**About VZY**

VZY is building the aggregation layer for how India streams. We bring the country’s OTT services together into one experience, with one login, one payment, and one place to find something worth watching, all running on our own billing and entitlement infrastructure. We think of it as infrastructure with a screen: the plumbing that makes streaming effortless, wrapped in a product people actually enjoy opening.

**About role**

At VZY, discovery is the product. When someone opens the app, everything they see (the home layout, the ranking, the rails, the curated shelves, the sense that something was picked just for them) is the discovery surface. It’s also the biggest lever we have on whether people come back and press play again.

As Senior PM for Discovery, you’ll own that surface from end to end. You’ll set the vision for how people find something to watch across dozens of services and thousands of titles, and you’ll ship the systems that make it work: the layout engine, search, the ranking and recommendation stack, personalization for very different kinds of viewers, and our new curator-led editorial shelves. You’ll work day to day with data science, engineering, editorial, and design, and you’ll help shape the discovery team as it grows.

Our North Star is Weekly Active Streamers, not installs and not sign-ups. Success looks like getting people to press play, and then to keep coming back.

**What you’ll own**

* The layout engine that assembles a personalized home surface for every user, along with the roadmap for making it smarter, faster, and easier to configure.
* Ranking and recommendations, working with data science on the models behind the rails, rows, and results, and deciding what relevance actually means for us.
* Search, so that when someone arrives knowing exactly what they want, they get to it in one try, and when they only half-know, they still land on something worth watching.
* Personalization across very different viewers (language, genre, price sensitivity, household versus individual), so the surface adapts to each one without the product coming apart at the seams.
* Our curator-led editorial shelves, the authored and followable format we’re building with the curation team. You’ll own the product side of how those shelves live inside the layout.
* Discovery analytics: the dashboards, funnels, and experiments that tell us whether any of this is actually working.

**What we’re looking for**

* 7 to 10 years in product, with real time spent owning search, recommendations, discovery, or user growth at consumer scale.
* A track record of AI and ML powered product work, where machine learning was the heart of the experience rather than a feature bolted on afterward. You can reason clearly about models, the tradeoffs they carry, and the ways they fail.
* Experience building automation that scales, the kind of system that replaces a hundred manual decisions (ranking, tagging, layout, targeting) with one that learns. Ideally you’ve done this somewhere in entertainment or media.
* Comfort with user growth problems like activation, retention, and the habit loops that turn a first stream into a weekly one, including ownership of the metrics underneath them.
* Strong data instincts. You can define the right metrics, design honest experiments, and tell a real signal from a vanity one, all in close partnership with data science.
* A feel for content and taste, because discovery in entertainment is as much editorial and emotional as it is algorithmic.
* The seniority to work through ambiguity, set a direction others can follow, and bring along the more junior PMs on the team.
* It’s a plus if you’ve worked in OTT, streaming, media, or music, or on aggregator or marketplace products where discovery drives the whole business.

**Why this role**

You’ll be the person who decides how a whole country finds what to watch, with real infrastructure, a listed parent company, and leadership backing the bet. Discovery isn’t a side project at VZY. It’s what we compete on.

And it’s a genuinely good team to spend your days with. Small, low on ego and politics, high on trust, with a real soft spot for people who care about getting the craft right.

title: Product Modernization - ACC+AJO Migration - Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We seek Senior Consultants and Architects with deep, hands-on expertise in Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC), Adobe Campaign Standard (ACS), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) to help enterprise customers modernize campaign and customer-journey programs. The role leads discovery, current-state assessment, target-state architecture, implementation, integration, testing, coexistence, cutover, and enablement. You will understand how customers use ACC or ACS today, identify use cases suited to AJO, and redesign them for AEP and AJO. Some functionality must be rebuilt, redesigned, retained, or handled through an integration or alternative solution. Candidates must explain product boundaries, assess feature and use-case fit, surface gaps early, and set realistic customer expectations. In AJO, a migrated use case lands on AJO Journeys (profile-centric, event-driven orchestration on AEP Real-Time Customer Profile) or AJO Orchestrated Campaigns (campaign-centric, batch, multi-step workflows on the AEP relational data store). Candidates must design and build on both, and recommend the right path per use case.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
- Assess and plan
- Lead discovery workshops with marketing, campaign operations, data, architecture, security, mobile, and IT stakeholders.
- Inventory the Campaign estate: use cases (batch, scheduled, transactional, event-triggered, real-time); assets (campaigns, workflows, audiences, deliveries, templates, content blocks, personalization, typologies, suppression rules, reporting); data (schemas and extensions, custom resources, relational data, targeting dimensions, identifiers, consent, opt-out, quarantine, bounce, engagement history); and infrastructure (on-premises or Managed Services hosting, network access, firewalls, file transfer, decommissioning needs).
- Reverse-engineer custom logic and document the business rules: technical and marketing workflows (query, enrichment, split, deduplication, reconciliation, update data, JavaScript code activities), custom JavaScript, JSSP, SOAP/JS API calls, SQL functions, stored procedures, custom relational structures, typology rules, input forms, web applications, landing pages, subscriptions, Message Center, Triggers/pipeline, offer logic, external accounts, APIs, middleware, and enterprise integrations.
- Map each use case and dependency to an AJO/AEP target pattern and classify it as reuse, redesign, rebuild, integrate, defer, or retain elsewhere. For custom logic, decide whether to re-express it in AEP/AJO (data model, Query Service, custom actions, external services), redesign or rebuild it separately, or retain it in Campaign.
- Choose the execution path per use case based on the target customer experience, not the shape of the source Campaign workflow. Use AJO Journeys when each profile should progress individually based on behaviour, events, or elapsed time, including many scheduled and recurring Campaign workflows rebuilt as Read Audience or business-event journeys. Use Orchestrated Campaigns for relational or multi-entity data, complex audience construction and enrichment, exact pre-send counts, and multi-level sending. Use action campaigns for simple scheduled or API-triggered sends. Document the rationale, combined patterns, and license prerequisites (e.g., the Journey Optimizer Campaigns package).
- Surface product-fit gaps and operational impacts before committing to scope or feature-parity claims. Advise when Campaign coexistence or another path fits better: Campaign v8 for ACC customers, or the ACS-to-Campaign v8 transition for ACS customers.
- Develop phased roadmaps, effort estimates, dependency plans, risks, and customer decision points.
- Architect and implement
- Design the AEP foundation: XDM schemas and field groups (profile, event, lookup); identity namespaces, identity resolution, profile enablement, and data relationships; datasets, sources, destinations, batch and streaming ingestion, and event design; data quality and governance; audience qualification and segmentation; and Query Service or other processing for transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.
- Replace common Campaign data patterns with AEP capabilities: Federated Audience Composition on Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or other warehouses (closest to ACC Federated Data Access); computed attributes for profile-level aggregates; Data Distiller for scheduled SQL transformations; merge policies; and profile and segmentation guardrails.
- Design customer experiences and build AJO journeys and campaigns across batch and event-driven engagement: event- and segment-triggered orchestration, conditions, actions, custom actions, message content, personalization, and decisioning.
- Apply journey and campaign governance and optimization: business rules, frequency capping, quiet hours, journey priority and arbitration, conflict management, wave sending, content experimentation, and decisioning policies and rankings.
- Define security, access, permissions, governance, and operational controls.
- Build channels, integrations, and extensibility
- Configure AJO channels end to end: email, mobile and web push, in-app, web, code-based experiences, content cards, inbox, live activities, SMS/MMS, RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, and direct mail. Cover channel configurations, subdomains, API credentials, feedback webhooks, mobile app and SDK dependencies, channel-specific data and consent requirements, and template approval rules (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta).
- Connect messaging providers: native SMS providers (Sinch, Twilio, Infobip); bring-your-own-provider (BYOP) setups with provider payloads, inbound keyword handling, delivery receipts, and opt-in/opt-out webhooks and flows; and Channel Builder custom channels for non-native platforms or customer-owned gateways (e.g., regional or industry-specific providers), covering endpoint, authentication, throttling, payload structure, and monitoring.
- Design and build integrations using supported APIs, source connectors, file exchange, middleware, or Adobe solution integrations, including custom actions that call external systems from journeys (CRM, loyalty, order, recommendation, call-center, notification services) with request/response schemas, authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS), capping, throttling, retries, and error handling.
- Implement event and API-triggered patterns: unitary and business events, API-triggered and transactional campaigns, Interactive Message Execution / Journey and Campaign APIs, and streaming ingestion via HTTP API.
- Design and build Journeys (profile-centric)
- Select and configure the journey entry pattern per use case: unitary-event journeys for behavioural and transactional signals; audience qualification journeys on streaming audiences for real-time lifecycle moments; Read Audience journeys, one-shot or recurring with incremental read, for scheduled and batch-initiated programs that previously ran as recurring Campaign workflows; and business-event journeys that release an audience when an operational event occurs (e.g., a price drop or flight delay). Configure identity namespaces, reentrance and wait periods, exit criteria, and time zones.
- Build multi-step journeys where each customer progresses at their own pace: Wait activities; the Optimize activity for conditions, path targeting, and path experiments; reaction events on opens and clicks with timeout paths; Update Profile; Content Decision for offers; external data sources and custom actions for real-time lookups and system writebacks; and Jump activities to split complex programs into reusable journeys.
- Use supplemental identifiers (e.g., order, booking, subscription, or policy IDs), where enabled, to run one journey instance per entity and personalize with its attributes. Decide when per-entity use cases fit journeys versus orchestrated campaign multi-level sending.
- Support phased migration and coexistence from the journey canvas, including Adobe Campaign v7/v8 and ACS actions that let AJO orchestrate while Campaign transactional messaging delivers, until channels and content move to native AJO.
- Design within journey guardrails (one active instance per profile per journey, one Read Audience per journey and concurrent-run limits, entrance and processing throughput per sandbox, Jump and supplemental identifier restrictions, reaction event placement, custom action capping, and versioning impact on live profiles). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Design and build Orchestrated Campaigns (relational)
- Design the data model with AEP relational (model-based) schemas, built manually or from a DDL or Excel upload: tables, primary and composite keys, version descriptors (e.g., lastmodified), ENUMs, data governance labels, identity fields mapped to identity namespaces, and links with correct cardinality (1-N, N-1, 1-1) to recipient and profile entities.
- Configure target dimensions, including the profile target dimension linking XDM profile and experience event data to relational data; decide what belongs in the profile store versus relational tables to avoid duplication.
- Set up Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion from supported sources (e.g., Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Databricks, Data Landing Zone): the \_change\_request\_type field for file-based loads, table logging for cloud warehouses, complete-record loads, deletion handling, and latency planning.
- Build multi-step canvases with targeting, flow control, and channel activities (Build, Read, and Save audience, Enrichment, Change dimension, Combine, Deduplication, Reconciliation, Split, Fork, AND-join, Wait, Alert), including multi-entity segmentation and multi-level sending (e.g., one message per booking, contract, subscription, account, or address linked to a profile) personalized with enriched relational attributes. Configure scheduling, recurring runs, and pre-send count validation.
- Design within orchestrated campaign guardrails (table count and schema size limits, daily change-volume limits, scalar-only audience attributes, uncached audience evaluation, permanent dataset table names, channel availability by license). Flag gaps to the customer early.
- Migrate data, logic, and personalization
- Translate the ACC/ACS relational data model to AEP: map recipient, custom, and relational tables to XDM profile, experience event, and lookup schemas, or to relational schemas for orchestrated campaigns; define primary and secondary identities, relationships, cardinality, and denormalization trade-offs.
- Migrate historical and operational data (profile attributes, subscriptions, consent and opt-out status, quarantine and bounce history, engagement data) via batch backfill, delta loads, and reconciliation reports. Map ACC/ACS denylist and subscription data to the AEP Consent and Preferences field group and AJO subscription lists; load quarantined and bounced addresses into the AJO suppression list via the Suppression API so blocked recipients stay blocked from day one.
- Rebuild Campaign workflow logic according to the chosen path. For journeys, express targeting as AEP audiences (batch, streaming, or edge) and computed attributes, recurring workflows as scheduled Read Audience journeys, and waits, splits, and tests as Wait and Optimize activities. For orchestrated campaigns, rebuild queries, enrichments, splits, union/intersection/exclusion, deduplication, change dimension, and reconciliation as canvas activities. Use Query Service (SQL/CTAS) jobs or source dataflows for scheduled imports/exports and data preparation. Move logic neither canvas supports (JavaScript activities and code, SQL code, loops, file manipulation) to the source system, Query Service or Data Distiller, or external services.

For journeys, express targeting as AEP audiences (batch, streaming, or edge) and computed attributes, recurring workflows as scheduled Read Audience journeys, and waits, splits, and tests as Wait and Optimize activities. For orchestrated campaigns, rebuild queries, enrichments, splits, union/intersection/exclusion, deduplication, change dimension, and reconciliation as canvas activities. title: AI Lead - Agentic
description:
**Job Requirements**
Act as a Business Partner to develop embedded Agentic Business Processes and Identify, Design & Deliver AI Agents that create measurable Business Value. The incumbent will partner with Business teams to convert operational challenges into intelligent Agentic AI solutions, decision intelligence and natural language interaction with enterprise data.
  
  

* The role will drive Jakson Group's Agentic AI journey by combining business process understanding with modern Microsoft AI technologies including Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
* Architect, build, deploy and maintain enterprise agents using Azure AI Foundry & Python. Define agent workflows, orchestration logic, business rules and exception handling.
* Lead end-to-end Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC) comprising use-case identification, functional requirement documentation, agent design & technical specifications, agent development, quality assurance, user acceptance and continuous improvement & support.
* Own Documentation and adherence to change control policies & procedures.
* Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to identify agentic opportunities and translate business use case into measurable success criteria for agentic initiatives. Prioritise use cases based on business impact, feasibility, data readiness and strategic alignment.
* Act as a strategic link between business stakeholders, shared IT COEs and agentic solution partners to facilitate development & deployment of LLM-based AI agents.
* Implement agents with appropriate information security, governance and compliance controls. Develop & ensure compliance with Data & AI policies, standard operating procedures and data governance. Ensure timely upgrades of landscape to latest standards.
* Conduct workshops, demonstrations, training sessions for adoption and realised business benefits.
* Collaborate with Data & AI team for solution architecture, data quality & readiness and agent development.
* Organize scheduled progress reviews and track deliveries as per agreed timelines & cost and provide updates to business stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Data & AI vendors and periodically review SLA adherence & delivery quality.
* Own uptime, integrity, performance, security and support SLA adherence of AI technology landscape.
* Stay updated with the latest AI technologies and industry trends to drive continuous improvement.

**Work Experience**
**Technical & Functional Skills:**
B.E. / B. Tech (Computer Science / Data Science or a related field)
  
  

* 12+years of experience in Data Science & Analytics with minimum 3 years in a lead role for agent development.
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, LLM integrations, and Python programming for data engineering and machine learning.
* Knowledge of Power BI & Microsoft Fabric including OneLake, Data Factory & Synapse.
* Deployed at least one AI agent from conceptualization to design to delivery in a large enterprise.
* Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple functions.

title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location:**
Noida (Work from Office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
2+ Years
  
  
**About Sustainiam**
Sustainiam is a climate technology company building digital infrastructure for global environmental markets. Our platform enables the end-to-end lifecycle of carbon and environmental credits—from project registration and monitoring to verification, issuance, trading (exchange and OTC), and reporting.
  
  
We empower businesses, project developers, and ecosystem stakeholders with technology-driven solutions across renewable energy, carbon removal, waste management, nature-based solutions, and community-led sustainability initiatives. By combining innovation with transparency, Sustainiam is accelerating the transition to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.
  
  
At Sustainiam, you'll have the opportunity to build products that solve complex global challenges while working alongside a passionate team dedicated to creating meaningful environmental impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who can take complete ownership of product strategy, execution, and growth for our climate-tech platform.
  
  
As a Product Manager, you will work closely with founders, engineering, design, business, and operations teams to build scalable fintech and marketplace products that simplify carbon credit registration, issuance, trading, and reporting. You'll be responsible for identifying customer needs, defining product strategy, driving execution, and delivering measurable business impact.
  
  
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and has experience building successful B2B SaaS or fintech products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Drive product discovery by understanding customer pain points, market trends, and competitive landscape.
* Prioritize features based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Own the complete product lifecycle from ideation to launch and continuous improvement.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Work closely with Engineering and Design teams to deliver high-quality product releases.
* Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and agile product development processes.
* Ensure timely delivery while maintaining product quality and user experience.

**Customer & Market Insights**

* Conduct customer interviews, usability testing, and market research.
* Analyze product usage, customer feedback, and key metrics to improve product performance.
* Stay updated with emerging trends in fintech, climate technology, carbon markets, and B2B SaaS.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations teams for successful product launches.
* Support go-to-market strategy, pricing, product positioning, and adoption initiatives.
* Present product updates and strategic recommendations to leadership.

**Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and monitor product KPIs and success metrics.
* Leverage analytics to optimize user journeys, product adoption, and business outcomes.
* Make informed decisions based on data, customer insights, and experimentation.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 2+ years of Product Management experience..
* Prior experience working in a high-growth startup environment (Mandatory).
* Hands-on experience building Fintech products (Mandatory).
* Strong experience with B2B SaaS products and product-led development.
* Proven track record of owning products from concept to launch.
* Excellent understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on marketplaces, exchanges, payments, trading platforms, or financial products.
* Exposure to Climate Tech, Carbon Markets, ESG, Sustainability, or Renewable Energy domains.
* Familiarity with APIs, data platforms, dashboards, and analytics tools.
* Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar.
* Understanding of AI-enabled products or workflow automation is an added advantage.

**What You'll Gain**

* Opportunity to build category-defining products in the rapidly growing climate-tech sector.
* High ownership with direct access to founders and leadership.
* Work on products creating measurable environmental and business impact.
* Collaborative, fast-paced startup culture with significant learning opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth.

**Why Join Sustainiam?**

* Build innovative fintech and climate-tech products with global impact.
* Be part of a mission-driven startup transforming environmental markets through technology.
* Work alongside talented engineers, designers, and business leaders in a highly collaborative environment.
* Shape the future of carbon markets and sustainable finance while solving real-world challenges.

**Perks And Benefits**
**Culture & Celebrations:**

* Fun Fridays, monthly team parties, and festival celebrations.
* Recognition for contributions and milestones.
* Financial & Lifestyle Benefits:
* Medical insurance for self and family.
* Meal pass and daycare facilities.
* Upskilling budget.
* Air travel accident coverage, personal accident insurance.
* Office & Facilities:
* On-site gym and game zones.
* Access to cricket, tennis, and badminton courts.
* Creche and food outlets on campus.

**Ready to shape the future of climate tech with us? Apply now and join our team!**

title: Principal Lead-Product Owner
description:
**About Our Company**
Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
  
  
Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Architecture Product Owner is responsible for managing and evolving the Enterprise Architecture operating model, products, governance processes, work management practices, and knowledge repositories. The role serves as the central coordination point for architecture planning, execution tracking, governance, process maturity, documentation standards, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role requires close collaboration with Enterprise Architects and Technology Leaders to improve adoption of architecture standards, governance processes, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps
  
  
The individual drives consistent adoption of architecture processes maintains operational discipline across architecture teams, and drives transparency through effective governance, metrics, Jira management, and executive reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product ownership, program management, and Agile delivery expertise with a solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture practices and governance. They are highly organized, process-driven, and experienced in Jira and Confluence administration, Scrum and Kanban methodologies, backlog management, story-point estimation, executive reporting, and documentation governance. The individual will drive operational excellence, process maturity, transparency, and adoption across the Enterprise Architecture function.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own the roadmap, backlog, adoption strategy, and operational metrics for Enterprise Architecture products, services, and governance capabilities.
  
  
Define, document, govern, and continuously improve Enterprise Architecture processes, standards, workflows, templates, and operating procedures.
  
  
Serve as the owner of the Enterprise Architecture operating model, ensuring consistent execution of architecture governance, planning, review, and lifecycle management processes.
  
  
Manage architecture work intake, prioritization, planning, capacity management, and execution tracking across the Enterprise Architecture team.
  
  
Act as the Jira and Confluence subject matter expert, administering workflows, automations, dashboards, reporting, templates, and knowledge repositories.
  
  
Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices, including backlog management, story creation, story-point estimation, sprint planning, Kanban flow management, and milestone tracking.
  
  
Establish and maintain architecture documentation standards, architecture artifacts, governance records, and knowledge repositories to ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible.
  
  
Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reports that provide visibility into architecture demand, priorities, capacity, risks, dependencies, progress, and business outcomes.
  
  
Facilitate architecture governance forums, architecture reviews, planning sessions, retrospectives, and cross-functional working sessions.
  
  
Drive accountability for maintaining accurate work items, status updates, milestones, architecture artifacts, and governance records within Jira and Confluence.
  
  
Establish and track KPIs, maturity metrics, adoption measures, and performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of Enterprise Architecture services and governance practices.
  
  
Prepare executive presentations, leadership communications, governance updates, status reports, and decision-support materials.
  
  
Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance architecture planning, governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
12+ years of overall experience in technology program management, Agile delivery, PMO, delivery management, or related discipline.
  
  
Demonstrated experience as a Program Manager, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role within a technology organization.
  
  
Strong practical experience with Jira administration, including workflow configuration, automation, dashboards, filters, and reporting.
  
  
Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and driving accountability without direct reporting authority.
  
  
Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and follow-up skills.
  
  
Experience preparing executive dashboards, leadership presentations, status reporting, and decision-support materials.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and operate effectively with senior leaders and architects.
  
  
Broad understanding of enterprise technology domains, including cloud, networking, security, data, platform engineering, and AI, with the ability to collaborate effectively with architects across these areas.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Working knowledge of AWS cloud concepts and services.
  
  
Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture practices, governance processes, and technology portfolio management.
  
  
Experience with Confluence, Power BI, Jira and similar collaboration and reporting tools.
  
  
Understanding of AI productivity tools and their practical application to workflow automation, reporting, and knowledge management.
  
  
Experience establishing governance routines and operating processes for technology teams.
  
  
Agile, Scrum, Jira, project management, or program management certification.
  
  
In-Office Collaboration
  
  
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2) days per week.
