title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Project Lead (Search and Match)
description:
BOLD is seeking for senior professional who will combine analytical skills and business knowledge to deliver key insights to our Product and Management teams. You’ll help drive product development using our vast user data sets to enhance our current products and to help us find inferences and relationships in this data to build new products – More towards the role required.
  
  
**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.
  
  
Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.
  
  
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate ability to work on data science projects involving NLP, large language models, predictive modelling, statistical analysis, vector space modelling, machine learning etc.
* Leverage our rich data sets of user data to perform research, develop models and create data products with our Development & Product teams
* Develop novel and scalable data systems in cooperation with our system architects that leverage datasets using machine learning techniques to enhance the user experience
* Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end products & features.
* Demonstrates ability to multi-task and re-prioritize responsibilities based on changing requirements.
* Estimates efforts, identify risks, devises and meets project schedules.
* Runs review meetings effectively and drive the closure of all open issues on time.
* Evolve prompt engineering applications and benchmark different Large Language models to solve business problems.
* Mentors/coaches data scientists to facilitate their development and provide technical leadership to them.
* Implement and experiment with agentic workflows to improve the job seeker experience.
* Rises above detail to see broader issues and implications for whole product/team.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Should be able to handle a team of 2-5 members, if required.
* Knowledge and experience using statistical and machine learning algorithms, including regression, instance-based learning, decision trees, Bayesian statistics, clustering, neural networks, deep learning, ensemble methods.
* Expert knowledge in Python.
* Experience with frameworks that optimizes prompt engineering (langChain/crewai/etc)
* Practical LLM/RAG experience for search quality  such as  query understanding, semantic retrieval, reranker design .
* Experience with Solr/OpenSearch/Elasticsearch.
* Experience with embedding & vector search .
* Experience in using large language models.
* Experience with distributed, semantic and vector based search and match systems.
* Experience with prompt engineering, chain-of-thought, retrieval augmented generation, vector databases and preferably LLM agents.
* Experience in feature selection, building and optimizing classifiers.
* Experience with software stack components, including common programming languages, back-end technologies, database modelling, continuous integration, services-oriented architecture, software testability, etc.
* Langchain and/or Llamaindex.
* Be a keen learner and enthusiastic about developing software.

**EXPERIENCE-**

* Project Lead (Search & Match)- 8 years+

**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**

* Competitive salary
* Tax-friendly compensation structure
* Bi-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company

**100% Full Health Benefits**

* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, & term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage

**Flexible Time Away**

* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)

**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**

* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick-up and drop-off facility

**About BOLD**
**We Transform Work Lives**
As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.
  
  
**We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion**
We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. We don't discriminate regarding race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law.

title: Engineering Manager - System Design
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
  
  
As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
  
  
Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
  
  
Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
  
  
**Technical Implementation Manager**
The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints.
  
  
Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.

**Key Competencies**

* Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%)

**Technical Skills**
**Required:**

* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework

**Preferred:**

* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints

**Qualifications – Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles
* Experience deploying multi-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments
* Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware
* Customer-facing experience, including independent travel to customer sites
* Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy.
**#TeamGreen**

title: Cyber Resilience - Product Owner
description:
**Product Owner - CyberResilience**

Location : Noida /Chennai

**Role Purpose**

Owns the Cyber Resilience portfolio end-to-end — a junior-CISO-calibre profile spanning the full security story (posture, defense, identity, cloud) plus the recovery/resilience differentiator. Fronts CISOs as a peer, and builds, prices and presells the portfolio as builder + presales dual-hat.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap, P&L input, and go-to-market narrative for all four Cyber Resilience propositions (Posture, Defense, Recovery, Assurance) until deal volume justifies dedicated proposition-level Product Owners.
* Act as lead presales solutioner and CISO-facing voice on cyber resilience pursuits — shaping RFP/bid responses, running technical win themes, and closing recovery- and resilience-heavy deals alongside account teams.
* Define and evolve the portfolio's commercial constructs — service catalogue, tiering, SLAs/service credits, at-risk and resource-unit (RU) pricing — in partnership with finance, legal, and delivery.
* Direct and prioritize the technical pool (Solution Architect and partner delivery teams) against a single backlog, translating deal and audit commitments into build decisions.
* Own the regulatory, audit, and cyber-insurance narrative — DORA/operational-resilience evidence, SOX/PCI/ISO posture, and insurer/underwriter conversations on exposure and recoverability.
* Manage the strategic partner bench (recovery platform vendors, IR retainers, SOC/MDR delivery partners) — sourcing and back-to-back contracting — while building the case for proposition-level splits.

**Hard Skills**

* **Security domain breadth (prevent → detect → respond → recover)**
  — vulnerability/exposure and posture management, SOC/MDR/EDR operating constructs, incident response and DFIR — junior-CISO span across the full lifecycle.
* **Security architecture & zero trust**
  — NIST SP 800-207 zero trust, network segmentation/containment design, AD/Entra attack paths and privileged-access design; SASE/SSE awareness.
* **Threat & exposure management**
  — CTEM methodology across Tenable One/Qualys/Rapid7-class platforms and CNAPP/CSPM (Wiz, Defender for Cloud); MITRE ATT&CK literacy.
* **Security operations oversight**
  — SIEM/XDR ecosystem fluency (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike/Defender XDR), MDR service constructs, detection-maturity assessment — enough to own the offer without running the SOC.
* **Cloud security**
  — securing hybrid multi-cloud estates (Azure/AWS/GCP) — posture, identity and workload protection constructs.
* **Cyber recovery & resilience engineering**
  — immutable/air-gapped backup, cleanroom recovery, identity recovery (AD/Entra/Okta); Rubrik/Commvault-class platforms; regulated/bank-grade failover and recovery testing.
* **Outcome-based commercial design & productization**
  — SLAs and service credits, at-risk and resource-unit (RU) pricing, unit-cost modelling; service catalogue/tiering, build-vs-partner sourcing, back-to-back contracting.
* **Regulatory, frameworks & insurance**
  — NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001, DORA/operational resilience, SOX/PCI; cyber-insurance readiness and exposure quantification.
* **AI security & credentials**
  — securing AI/agents and AgentOps governance (identity, audit, guardrails); CISSP/CCSP-class credential expectation.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**Overview**
Role:
**Principal Product Manager**
Shape how the world's businesses experience the value of AI, on mobile
  
  
Copilot is becoming the AI companion for how people work, and more of that work now happens on a phone. As Copilot grows more capable, with stronger models, agents and multimodal experiences, the opportunity is to help people and their organizations feel that value at exactly the right moment, so that choosing a paid plan feels like the obvious next step. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead commercial monetization for Copilot on mobile and define what great AI monetization looks like on the screen people carry everywhere.
  
  
Why this role, why now
  
  
Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, bringing chat, agents and creation into a single experience for consumers and businesses. Monetization is moving inside the product, where value is felt. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is now live on iOS and Android. The playbook for monetizing AI at this scale is still being written, and you will help write it.
  
  
How we work
  
  

* Small, empowered mission team with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* Trust first: we earn every upgrade.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…
  
  

* You treat monetization as product craft, not a pricing afterthought.
* You form a clear point of view, test it quickly and change it when the data says so.
* You turn ambiguity into a strategy others can rally around.
* You align teams you don't manage with clarity, rigor and generosity.
* You grow product managers and raise the bar on experimentation.
* You already use AI to work faster and want a team that does the same.

This role may not be for you if…
  
  

* You prefer a defined roadmap handed to you.
* You measure success in features shipped rather than customers who value what they pay for.
* You would rather wait for perfect data than make a well-reasoned call.

Why join us
  
  
Few roles let you shape how AI is experienced and valued by businesses around the world. You will work on a global product with the ownership to set direction, alongside a fast-moving, AI-native team. If building the future of AI monetization on mobile excites you, we would love to meet you.
  
  
In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
What you will own
  
  
As the product leader accountable for commercial monetization on mobile, you set the strategy, choose the best and own the business outcome, from first idea to launch to decision.
  
  

* Paid growth: turn in-app interest into paid Microsoft 365 Copilot subscriptions for businesses of every size.
* Effortless purchase: experiences that make it simple for people and their organizations to say yes, on any device.
* The right moment: well-timed, value-led upgrade experiences across Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps on mobile.
* New ways to buy: shape emerging models, including usage-based offers, as AI capabilities expand.
* A team and an engine: lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner with engineering, design, data science, marketing and business teams to build an experimentation engine that compounds.

Success means measurable growth in paid conversion, subscriptions and revenue, earned in a way customers trust.
  
  
**Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* First 30 days: understand customers, product and data end to end, and build trust with partners across the company.
* By 60 days: set a clear monetization strategy with prioritized, hypothesis-led bets.
* By 90 days: first bets live and measured rigorously, with a team rallying around the plan.

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 10 years experience in Product Management

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
**Other Requirements:**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree AND 10+ years of product management experience, SaaS or mobile products at scale, OR a master's degree AND 8+ years.

+ OR equivalent experience.

* A proven record of growth or monetization outcomes you personally drove.
* Experience with B2B or product-led growth products.

* Mobile app store and in-app purchase experience on iOS and Android.

title: Associate Director - Product
description:
Technical Product Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Noida / Remote / Hybrid
  
  
**Department:**
Product & Technology
  
  
**Reports To:**
Chief Executive Officer (Product Strategist)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can own a product end to end — from the first spark of an idea through design, development, and launch. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks like a designer, understands code and system architecture, and can turn ambiguous problems into shipped products.
  
  
This role is unique in two ways. First, product direction comes from our CEO acting as Product Strategist: you will operate with a strong Business Analyst mindset, eliciting requirements from strategic conversations and turning high-level vision into precise, buildable specifications. You will do the same with very non-technical stakeholders — including the CFO and other executives — converting business and financial needs into clear product requirements. Second, we run a Rapid Development Framework with sprints executed in 2-day cycles, so speed of translation from idea to working prototype to shipped increment is the core skill of this job.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Requirements from the Product Strategist — Work directly with the CEO/Product Strategist to capture product vision and strategy; run structured elicitation sessions, ask the questions that surface hidden requirements, and translate strategic intent into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Business analysis with non-technical stakeholders — Elicit and document requirements from non-technical executives such as the CFO — interviewing, workshopping, and process-mapping to convert business, financial, and operational needs into unambiguous specifications developers can build from.
* Rapid prototyping & sign-off — Build rapid prototypes (wireframes, clickable mockups, working demos in tools like Figma or lightweight code) within hours or days, walk stakeholders through them, incorporate feedback in fast iteration loops, and drive to formal sign-off before development begins.
* 2-day sprint cycles — Operate our Rapid Development Framework: plan, scope, and close sprints on 2-day cycles; break features into increments buildable within a cycle; run tight stand-ups; and keep a continuously groomed, developer-ready backlog.
* Developer collaboration — Collaborate daily with engineers to scope feasibility, make speed/quality/scope trade-offs in real time, unblock development, and coordinate QA and launch readiness in a fast-paced environment.
* Roadmap & metrics — Own the roadmap for your product area, prioritizing by customer impact, business value, and technical effort; define and track post-launch metrics and use data to drive the next iterations.
* Communication — Communicate progress, decisions, and trade-offs clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, adapting your style for engineers, designers, executives, and customers.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Experience owning products end to end — concept through design, development, and post-launch iteration — not just managing a backlog.
* Strong Business Analyst skillset: proven ability to elicit requirements from senior, strategy-level stakeholders (CEO/founder level) and from non-technical executives (CFO, operations leaders), and to document them as clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Demonstrated rapid prototyping ability — wireframing, prototyping, and using tools such as Figma — with a track record of getting stakeholder sign-off quickly and using prototypes to de-risk development.
* Experience in accelerated or rapid development environments (short sprint cycles, RAD, or continuous delivery); comfort planning and shipping in 2-day sprint cycles.
* Solid technical foundation: comfortable reading code, understanding APIs and system architecture, and having informed technical conversations with engineers without necessarily writing production code.
* Strong product thinking — able to break vague problems into structured, testable hypotheses and make sound trade-off decisions under time pressure.
* Comfort using data to decide: defining metrics, analyzing funnels, and running experiments such as A/B tests.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with shifting priorities and direct executive visibility.
* Typically 7 to 12 years in product management and business analysis, with prior experience in software engineering, design, or a technical role a strong plus.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with SaaS or B2B products; prior startup or early-stage experience where you wore multiple hats.
* Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting for pulling and analyzing your own data.
* Exposure to design systems and component libraries.
* Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as the primary source of product direction.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Relentlessly drive for continual product improvements and deliver results that exceed quality expectations. Work closely with user experience and engineering teams to refine, test and build experiences. Analyze current business processes and make recommendations for improvement based on industry trends and professional business knowledge.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Product Strategy and Planning: Define and execute the product strategy, aligning with overall business goals. Facilitate and manage the product lifecycle and continuously iterate to improve the product and be responsible for turning that complexity into a simple user experience.
* Drive the execution of the product lifecycle processes including product research, market research, competitive analysis, planning, positioning, roadmap development, requirements gathering and product launch.
* Presales Support: Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and contribute to the pre-sales process.
* Create compelling product presentations and collateral to support sales efforts
* Product Development: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including development, design, and quality assurance, to bring products from concept to production.
* Create Epics and Stories into features, defined within the backlog platform (JIRA/Azure Board) and prioritization of these for the roadmap.
* Prioritize and manage the product backlog, ensuring timely delivery of features and enhancements.
* Integrate usability studies, customer feedback, research, and market analysis into product requirements to enhance customer satisfaction.
* Partner with stakeholders, delivery teams, customer experience product teams, development teams, and support teams to assess, initiate, prioritize, refine, and drive products and solutions.
* Client Engagement: Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand requirements, and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Act as a liaison between clients and internal teams to address any product-related issues.
* Performance Monitoring: Analyse product performance to understand key performance drivers and gaps including, but not limited to, product content, competitiveness, pricing, marketing and sales enablement.

**Requirements**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) IRC306872
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a high-caliber Principal / Lead Cloud AI Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern Enterprise AI paradigms. In this hybrid hands-on and customer-facing role, you will lead the architecture, design, and deployment of scalable microservices, distributed systems, and cutting-edge GenAI/Agentic solutions.
  
  
You will own the complete solution lifecycle—from direct client discovery and architectural design to hands-on implementation and production deployment—translating complex, ambiguous business problems into secure, high-performance Cloud AI systems.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Core Development Track (Python or Java)

Strong, hands-on enterprise-level expertise in EITHER Python OR Java (Tracks are evaluated separately; expertise in at least one is mandatory).
  
  
Proven track record building enterprise microservices, REST APIs, and distributed event-driven applications.
  
  
  

* Technical & Cloud Architecture

Deep technical knowledge of distributed system design, enterprise application integration, and relational/non-relational database technologies.
  
  
Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) core services: Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.
  
  
Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and enterprise CI/CD automation pipelines.
  
  
  

* GCP AI & Machine Learning Ecosystem

Hands-on proficiency in building and deploying models via Vertex AI and integrating foundation models via the Gemini API.
  
  
Demonstrated experience constructing end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and configuring Vertex AI Vector Search for embeddings and semantic search.
  
  
Practical experience designing agentic AI workflows and establishing automated evaluation metrics (“evals”) for enterprise AI applications.
  
  
  

* Client & Leadership Capabilities

Experience in customer-facing roles, driving technical discovery, solutioning, and executive-level technical discussions.
  
  
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a track record of optimizing application performance.
  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, Healthcare, Enterprise SaaS) with strict security and compliance considerations.
  
  
Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-optimization strategies for large-scale GenAI workloads.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & System Design: Architect and implement resilient, scalable, and high-throughput enterprise systems and microservices using GCP-native cloud frameworks.
  
  
GenAI & Agentic Engineering: Build and deploy enterprise GenAI applications leveraging Vertex AI, Gemini API, Vertex AI Vector Search, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Establish automated evaluation loops (“evals”) to measure model performance, drift, and accuracy.
  
  
Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Lead end-to-end delivery—including technical requirement gathering, architectural blueprints, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), production integration, deployment, and performance optimization.
  
  
Cloud & DevOps Orchestration: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and manage containerized microservices across Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the technical authority in direct client engagements, translating business requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps and conducting technical deep dives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guide engineering teams through design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, establish best practices, and drive technical excellence across cross-functional initiatives.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the role**

As a
**Forward Deployed Engineer at**
SquadStack.ai, you’ll work on building and evolving production-grade Voice AI systems that customers actively use.

You’ll operate close to real deployments - identifying gaps surfaced by live usage, designing solutions, and shipping them into production. Some work moves fast; some work is planned and iterative. What matters is that priorities are driven by real customer outcomes, not by work defined quarters in advance.

You’ll leverage the SquadStack platform to configure, extend, and build AI-native workflows, while writing production-quality code where needed. You’ll work in a small pod alongside Customer Success and AI PM partners, owning technical execution end-to-end.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer reality -
**with a strong emphasis on code quality, system reliability, and long-term leverage over one-off fixes.**

***Apply even if you’re only 70% sure. The conversation itself is valuable.***

**What you'll do**

You’ll work in a
**small pod**
(CSM / AI PM handles customer communication; you handle technical execution), solving problems that block customer success but aren’t yet on the product roadmap
**.**

**Your engineering work includes:**

* Building custom integrations, tools, and AI workflows that unblock customer needs
* Designing and refining AI prompts, RAG systems, and LLM-based solutions
* Writing production-quality code (Python / JavaScript) with the same standards as core engineering
* Deciding whether solutions should remain custom, become reusable, or move into the core product
* Collaborating with core engineering teams to upstream learnings and reduce future friction.

**What you will
*not*
do:**

* Run customer calls
* Own accounts
* Chase stakeholders
* Do repetitive support work

**This is NOT solutions engineering**

You do not deliver one-off scripts and move on

Every solution is evaluated on leverage:

* Can this be reused?
* Can this become a product primitive?
* Can this eliminate future manual work?

Custom work is acceptable only if the business makes sense, or it is experimental, where we’d learn something new.

Strong solutions frequently get upstreamed into:

* Core platform capabilities
* Reusable internal tooling
* Product roadmap items owned by core engineering

**Your success is measured by reduced future friction - not by how many customers you personally unblock.**

**Code quality:**
Same high bar

**Technical difficulty:**
Often harder - real-world problems are messier and more near-term in nature than planned roadmaps

**Two engineering tracks - both valuable:**

**Core Engineering:**

* Product Roadmap
* Roadmap and sprint-driven
* Deep, well-scoped, long-lived
* Platform & system optimisation
* Slower, abstracted
* Platform Abstractions & scalability

**Customer Impact (This Role):**

* Day-to-day customer usage & success signals
* Signal-driven; flexible planning
* Broad, evolving, discovery-heavy
* Unblocking + generalising into scale
* Immediate, real-world
* Reduction of future friction & repeat issues

**Both are real engineering. Both lead to staff or lead roles. Both are equally respected.**

**Why ambitious engineers choose this role**

**🚀Unmatched learning velocity:**

* Build with cutting-edge AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG) in production
* Learn what actually makes products succeed in real markets
* Develop full-stack skills alongside business judgment

**⚡Real Autonomy:**

* Choose your own tools and approaches
* Ship when ready - not when a sprint ends
* Direct influence on the product roadmap & org metrics via real usage

**💪Career acceleration:**

Engineers from this track commonly become:

* Product Engineers who can both build and prioritise
* Technical Leads who deeply understand customer reality
* Founding Engineers or CTOs at startups with a complete skill stack

**🎯Immediate impact:**

* Direct feedback from real usage
* Clear line from your work to business outcomes

**What we’re looking for**

**Technical baseline:**

* Strong programming fundamentals (Python / JavaScript preferred,
  **but talent > language)**
* Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete requirements
* Curiosity about AI / ML in production (expertise is a bonus, not a requirement)

**Mindset fit:**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; drives problems to resolution even across unclear boundaries.
* **Pragmatic:**
  Focused on solutions that work now
* **Curious:**
  Wants to understand the “why” behind problems
* **Entrepreneurial:**
  Treats technical problems as business problems
* **Communicative:**
  Can translate technical decisions into a business context
* **AI Native:**
  Exposure to AI systems or prompt & context engineering.

**Should I apply?**

**YES, if you:**

* Want to work on AI-native products at the frontier
* Enjoy variety - no two weeks look the same
* Care about understanding the “why” behind what you build
* Prefer building solutions over strictly following specs
* I am curious about how engineering decisions affect business outcomes

**MAYBE NOT, if you:**

* Prefer predictable, tightly defined work
* Dislike exposure to business or customer context
* Need detailed specs to be productive
* Prefer large teams over small, autonomous pods
* Want to avoid ambiguity or rapid context-switching

**Day-to-day reality**

No two weeks look the same, but a typical flow might look like this:

* **Monday:**
  Pod sync to review customer progress and technical blockers. One issue stands out - a workflow the product doesn’t fully support yet.
* **Tuesday:**
  Prototype a solution (integration, tool, or AI workflow). Loop in core engineering early if it looks reusable.
* **Wednesday:**
  Refine the solution - edge cases, AI prompt behaviour, reliability. Decide whether this should remain custom or be generalised.
* **Thursday:**
  Ship to production. Monitor real usage. Iterate quickly if needed.
* **Friday:**
  Share learnings, move on to the next.

**Quick Check?**

* **Freedom level:**
  High
* **Bureaucracy:**
  Low
* **Learning curve:**
  Steep
* **Impact visibility:**
  Immediate and measurable

**Logistics**

* **Location:**
  Noida
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive!
* **Joining:**
  ASAP!

**Why should you consider us seriously?**

* We believe that long-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else.
* We are a well-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact & Flipkart; Co-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)
* Freedom and Responsibility 🦅
* Entrepreneurial Team 💪
* Exponential Growth 📈
* Healthcare (Physical & Mental Wellness) 😌

***Please Note:***

***SquadStack is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. SquadStack is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.***

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft 365 powers some of the world’s most critical productivity experiences at massive global scale. The M365 Core organization builds the foundational platforms that enable Microsoft 365 services to deploy, operate, scale, and evolve safely and efficiently.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to join the M365 Core team in Noida and help shape the future of our cloud infrastructure and safe deployment platforms.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, deployment and release management, reliability, developer experience, and AI. You will work closely with engineering teams and partner organizations to simplify complex infrastructure problems, build scalable platform capabilities, and rethink how AI can transform the way large-scale cloud services are developed and operated.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will:
  
  

* Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for foundational cloud infrastructure, deployment, and service-management capabilities.
* Partner deeply with engineering teams to solve complex problems in deployment, release safety, service reliability, infrastructure management, and developer productivity.
* Understand the needs of service engineering teams and translate them into scalable platform capabilities rather than point solutions.
* Build experiences that make it easier and safer for developers to deploy and operate services at cloud scale.
* Use product telemetry, customer feedback, operational signals, and engineering insights to identify opportunities and measure impact.
* Drive adoption of platform capabilities across multiple services and engineering teams.
* Simplify complex technical concepts into clear product priorities, requirements, and executive-level narratives.
* Work across organizational boundaries to align stakeholders, make thoughtful trade-offs, and drive results.

AI-Forward Product Leadership
  
  

* We are specifically looking for a PM who believes AI and agents can fundamentally change how cloud infrastructure is built and operated.

**You Will Explore Opportunities Such As**

* Applying AI to operational signals, deployment data, incidents, logs, and engineering knowledge to surface actionable insights.
* Creating intelligent and agentic experiences that help engineers diagnose problems and make better operational decisions.
* Automating repetitive operational and deployment workflows while maintaining appropriate safety and governance.
* Using AI to improve developer productivity and reduce the cognitive load associated with operating complex distributed systems.
* Rapidly prototyping AI-powered experiences with engineering teams and validating them with real users.
* Understanding the strengths and limitations of LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and emerging AI technologies and translating them into practical product opportunities.
* We are looking for someone who uses AI as an integral part of their own product management workflow, not simply someone who manages an AI feature.

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product management .

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
**Other Requirements:**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Solid product management experience delivering technically complex products or platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work closely with engineering teams on cloud services, infrastructure platforms, developer platforms, distributed systems, reliability, or related areas.
* Solid product thinking with the ability to move between customer problems, technical architecture, product strategy, and execution.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and create clarity and direction.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior engineering and product stakeholders.
* Solid analytical skills and a track record of using data to inform product decisions.
* Experience with large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform products.
* Understanding of CI/CD, deployment systems, service reliability, observability, incident management, or infrastructure automation.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted product development.
* Understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-based systems, evaluation, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience building products for developers or technical users.
* Ability to prototype ideas using AI-assisted development tools, scripting, data analysis, or lightweight application development.
* Experience driving platform adoption across multiple engineering organizations.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Platform Thinker You think beyond individual features and identify reusable capabilities that can solve classes of problems across a large cloud ecosystem.
* Technical Product Leader You are comfortable going deep with engineers on infrastructure, deployment, reliability, and architecture while maintaining a solid customer and product perspective.
* AI-Forward Builder You actively experiment with AI, understand where it genuinely changes the product experience, and push beyond simply adding AI features to existing workflows.
* Customer-Obsessed PM You understand the engineers and service teams using your platform, deeply investigate their friction points, and turn those insights into simple, scalable product experiences.

Why This Role
  
  

* This is an opportunity to work on foundational technologies that influence how some of Microsoft’s largest cloud services are deployed, operated, and protected at global scale.
* You will tackle problems where cloud infrastructure, safe deployment, reliability, developer productivity, and AI converge, with the opportunity to build capabilities that can benefit a broad set of services and engineering teams.
* We are looking for a PM who is comfortable with complexity, passionate about platforms, and excited to help define what an AI-native operating model for cloud services should look like.

#CAPIDC

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

description:

**Flexteam360 | Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India | On-site**

Flexteam360 is hiring for the Operations Product team of a leading German e-commerce company,
**Westwing (Westwing.com)**
, operating across 25+ European markets.

ABSOLUTE MUSTS - do not apply if you don't have these.

* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise OMS platform, preferably
  **Manhattan OMS / Active Omni, IBM Sterling OMS, and/or Fluent Commerce**

You will work closely with the Director of Product, based in Germany, to own and improve the Order Management System (OMS) powering the company's international e-commerce operations.

We are looking for an experienced
**OMS specialist with strong techno-functional expertise**
who understands enterprise order management platforms, can translate business requirements into functional solutions, and can drive system configuration, implementation, production stability, and continuous improvement.

* **Business collaboration:**

* **Continuous improvement:**
  Use operational data and automation opportunities to improve fulfilment performance and system reliability.

What we are looking for

**Essential requirements**

* Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, order orchestration, sourcing and allocation, fulfilment workflows, inventory availability, and exception handling.
* Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications, configurations, or system enhancements.
* Practical experience in production support, incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and SLA-driven environments.

* IBM Sterling OMS or Fluent Commerce Specialists

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager – Hardware & UAV Systems**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a results-driven
**Product Manager**
to lead the lifecycle of our next-generation drone platforms and hardware offerings. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex hardware engineering, firmware/software integration, and market demand. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—spanning electrical, mechanical, and embedded systems engineering-to translate market needs into scalable, high-performing physical products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and execute the product roadmap for hardware and drone systems in alignment with overall company vision and growth targets.
* Conduct continuous market research, competitive analysis, and teardowns to evaluate emerging trends in electronics, component availability, and UAV technology.
* Translate customer pain points and market opportunities into clear product requirement documents (PRDs), system specifications, and feature prioritization.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

* Partner directly with cross-functional teams—including Electronics/PCB Design, Mechanical, Embedded Firmware, Systems Engineering, and Operations—to drive hardware from concept to mass production.
* Oversee the full hardware lifecycle: concept design, prototyping, EVT/DVT/PVT stages, testing, manufacturing handoff, and post-launch iterations.
* Balance technical trade-offs regarding component selection, Bill of Materials (BOM) cost, power envelope, weight, reliability, and manufacturability (DFM/DFA).

**Customer & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Engage directly with enterprise customers and end-users to gather actionable feedback and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure component sourcing resilience and smooth transition to production.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to craft product positioning, pricing models, technical documentation, and go-to-market strategies.

**Metrics & Quality Control**

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across product adoption, unit economics, field reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize field telemetry and RMA/quality data to drive continuous hardware and firmware improvements.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline (MBA or MS preferred).
* **Experience:**
  Minimum
  **5+ years**
  of proven product management experience delivering hardware, embedded systems, electronics, or UAV/aerospace products.
* **Electronics & Hardware Domain:**
  Strong technical foundation in electronic systems, PCB assembly (PCBA) design cycles, sensor integration, microcontrollers, or power electronics.
* **Drone/UAV Knowledge:**
  Working familiarity with UAV architectures, flight controllers, telemetry, propulsion systems, or sensor payloads.
* **Execution:**
  Demonstrated track record of taking complex hardware/electronics products from initial schematic/concept stage through manufacturing and market launch.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on background in hardware engineering, embedded software design, or systems integration prior to transitioning into Product Management.
* Direct experience managing
  **BOM cost optimization**
  , supply chain dynamics, and component obsolescence strategies.
* Familiarity with global hardware certifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., FCC, CE, RoHS, FAA, DGCA, EASA).
* Experience working in fast-paced startup or rapid-hardware-prototyping environments.

title: Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
We are seeking a Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead to drive the delivery and governance of the SMBS AI programme. SMBS is building a live AI ecosystem — agents in production, workflows redesigned, outcomes measured. This is not a strategy exercise — we are building the next generation of our operational engine. This role does not build AI solutions directly — it ensures the conditions are in place for the build team to deliver effectively and for what is built to land with real operational impact.
  
  
This role owns the AI backlog and solution delivery assurance — governing what gets built and when, translating use case inputs from Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams into structured backlog items, and ensuring the build team works on the highest-impact opportunities. This is transformational delivery: systematically replacing manual, judgement-heavy processes with intelligent, scalable AI solutions. With typically 7+ years of experience in programme delivery or technology transformation, this is a role for someone experienced in moving from proof of concept to operational reality.
  
  
SMBS AI does not operate in isolation. This role coordinates across the full SimCorp AI ecosystem — Product AI, Platform and Infrastructure, AI Search and Knowledge, and Compliance and Legal — aligning standards, resolving dependencies, and leveraging what is being built across SimCorp. It also shapes how SMBS transitions into this next stage, influencing the AI guidelines, governance principles, and ways of working across DMS, IOS, and IAS.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
In your daily work, you will:
  
  

* Manage the interface between the SMBS AI team and all other SimCorp AI teams, ensuring alignment on standards, dependencies, and shared roadmaps.
* Maintain the Integration Dependency Register as the single source of truth for cross-team dependencies, blockers, and agreements.
* Represent the SMBS AI team in cross-company AI governance forums and steering committees.
* Facilitate the resolution of scope boundaries and overlapping use cases with the Product AI team.
* Own the AI use case backlog, ensuring use cases are consistently structured, scored, and prioritized using the established evaluation framework.
* Receive and structure use case inputs from service unit Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams.
* Coordinate sprint planning and release sequencing with the build team.
* Manage the intake of change requests for agents in production and prioritize them against new development.
* Prepare board and executive materials related to the AI initiative, including progress reporting, investment tracking, and impact measurement.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across service units, ensuring transparency on timelines, priorities, and delivery capacity.
* Drive the compliance and legal whitelisting process for AI tools and models, ensuring tooling is approved before the build team requires it.
* Ensure the AI initiative remains anchored in the service scalability strategy and does not drift into technology-for-technology’s-sake initiatives.

**What We Value**

* 7+ years of experience in program management, operational transformation, or service delivery leadership within financial services.
* Deep understanding of investment operations across Data Management, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple teams with competing priorities and without direct authority.
* Experience managing structured backlogs and prioritization frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation capabilities at senior and executive levels.
* You can hold a substantive conversation with AI engineers about agent design, model selection, and deployment trade-offs and translate those conversations into decisions and priorities that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
* You are a clear and confident communicator who can represent complex AI initiatives to executive audiences.
* You thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity where others see complexity.
* You have good English skills and are comfortable working in an international, cross-functional environment.
* You have effective collaboration skills and a bias for organizational alignment over individual delivery.

You operate as a senior individual contributor who influences outcomes through structure, clarity, and credibility — not through hierarchy. Your value is in making the system around you work better, not in being the one who executes.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self-Direction — High degree of self-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
  
  
We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Product Manager

**Senior Product Manager**

*STOEX India | Product Strategy & Delivery · Consumer Finance · 0→1*

**STOEX**
is a real-asset ownership platform designed to make ownership of real-world assets accessible, simple and transparent. The platform is launching with 24K gold and silver, with fractional real estate and private-market assets planned as future offerings.

The product enables users to purchase fractional ownership of allocated assets from a small ticket size, track their holdings on a public ledger, sell their holdings, or opt for physical delivery (for relevant assets). The underlying trust stack includes legal ownership structuring, custody, independent administration and auditing.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product strategy and execution for STOEX's consumer-facing asset ownership platform.

You will work across product, commercial, growth, engineering, design, CRM, operations, and compliance to build a seamless and trustworthy ownership experience. The role will have end-to-end ownership of key product journeys - from onboarding and KYC to first purchase, recurring investments, campaign management, portfolio management, selling, and physical delivery.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building products from the ground up, working with ambiguity, and translating complex financial/asset concepts into simple customer experiences.

**Location:**
*Noida (WFO- 5 days)/ Hybrid can be considered*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Own Product Strategy:**
  Define and execute the product roadmap across onboarding, KYC, asset discovery, purchase, recurring investments, portfolio management, selling, and physical delivery.
* **Drive Customer Activation & Retention:**
  Identify friction across the funnel - installs → KYC → first purchase → recurring ownership and build product interventions that improve activation, conversion, and long-term engagement.
* **Build Scalable Product Experiences:**
  Partner with engineering and design to build intuitive, reliable, and scalable experiences for asset discovery, transactions, portfolio tracking, payments, and ownership management.
* **Own Product Analytics:**
  Define product metrics, funnels, cohorts, experiments, and dashboards to understand user behaviour and continuously improve conversion and retention.
* **Cross-functional Execution:**
  Work closely with Growth, Marketing, Operations, Compliance, and business teams to translate commercial and customer needs into product initiatives.
* **Experiment & Iterate:**
  Establish a strong experimentation culture across onboarding, purchase flows, recurring investments, referrals, lifecycle journeys, and other key product experiences.
* **Trust & Compliance by Design:**
  Collaborate with legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure product journeys, communication, disclosures, and asset-related workflows are designed within applicable requirements.
* **Future Product Expansion:**
  Help build the product foundation for future asset categories, including silver, fractional real estate, and private markets.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* 8+ years of product management experience, preferably across FinTech, wealth-tech, payments, investment platforms, marketplaces, or consumer technology.
* Proven experience owning products end-to-end, from defining the problem and roadmap through execution, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Strong understanding of consumer funnels, transaction products, payments, investment products, recurring transactions, and lifecycle journeys.
* Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience using product analytics, experimentation, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and customer insights to make product decisions.
* Comfortable working in 0→1 / early-stage environments, with high ownership and ambiguity.
* Strong customer empathy and ability to simplify complex financial or asset-ownership concepts into intuitive product and user experiences.

Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.

Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

At the heart of their responsibilities, Product Managers act as the

They possess a keen understanding of market trends, consumer needs, and competitive landscapes. With their visionary approach, they identify potential product opportunities, conceptualize innovative ideas, and translate them into actionable plans.

The Chemical Intermediates business has acetic anhydride and value added anhydrides and aldehydes catering to various industries.

***Nutrition & Health Solutions:***
The Nutrition & Heath Solutions business unit offers B3 & Picolinates (Chromium & Zinc) which are fully backward integrated. Our ingredients find application in animal nutrition, human nutrition, personal care, etc. We provide high-quality feed & food additives having application in poultry, dairy, aqua & pet food industry. In Human Nutrition & Health Solutions, we offer food ingredients & premix solutions to nutrition.

Jubilant Ingrevia Limited is supported by five state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in India.
