title: Publishing Head
description:
Pegasus is looking for an experienced publishing leader to head our publishing and editorial function as we enter the next phase of our growth.
 



  





 We are not looking only for an editor.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can think about what children should read, learn, create and engage with — and translate those insights into commercially successful publishing products.
 



  





 Pegasus publishes children’s books and learning products across a wide range of categories, including storybooks, activity books, early learning, reference, workbooks, novelty formats, interactive books, puzzles, games and other screen\-free products.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Head of Publishing will be responsible for the overall publishing programme at Pegasus — from identifying opportunities and developing concepts to building the publishing list, managing editorial execution and ensuring products are relevant, differentiated and commercially viable.
 



  





 The role will work closely with Editorial, Design, R\&D, Production, Sales, Marketing and senior management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Publishing \& Product Strategy** 




  




* Build and manage the annual and long\-term publishing programme for Pegasus.
* Identify new categories, formats, concepts and publishing opportunities.
* Study international and Indian publishing trends, competition, consumer behaviour and emerging formats.
* Strengthen existing publishing categories while continuously developing new product propositions.
* Ensure the publishing list has the right balance of evergreen products, innovation, intellectual property and commercially scalable series.



**Product Development** 



* Take publishing projects from initial concept through final print\-ready product.
* Develop strong product briefs covering concept, age group, format, content, pricing, competitive positioning and differentiation.
* Work closely with editors, authors, illustrators and designers to achieve high editorial and visual standards.
* Review prototypes, manuscripts, layouts and product concepts at key stages of development.
* Ensure every product has a clearly defined consumer, purpose and reason to exist.
* Editorial Leadership



**Lead, mentor and develop the editorial and publishing team.** 



* Establish strong editorial standards, processes and review systems.
* Improve editorial quality, accuracy, creativity and consistency across the publishing programme.
* Manage internal editors as well as external authors, illustrators, freelancers and content partners.



**Research \& Innovation** 



* Build a strong culture of research before product development.
* Use market data, competitive products, customer feedback, sales insights and consumer testing to evaluate publishing ideas.
* Work closely with our internal R\&D process to validate new concepts before significant investment.
* Encourage experimentation while maintaining commercial discipline.



**Commercial Orientation** 



* Understand product economics including pricing, print quantities, production costs and expected market potential.
* Work closely with Sales and Marketing to understand what is working across distribution, modern trade, e\-commerce, international and direct\-to\-consumer channels.
* Review product and category performance and use this information to guide future publishing decisions.
* Identify opportunities to build successful series and intellectual properties rather than creating isolated titles.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Coordinate closely with Production and Purchase teams to ensure projects meet cost, quality and timeline requirements.
* Work with Marketing teams on product positioning, launch communication and content requirements.
* Support Sales teams with strong product understanding, cataloguing information and selling propositions.
* Ensure product metadata and publishing information are accurate and available to relevant teams.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Significant experience in publishing, preferably in children’s publishing, educational publishing, activity publishing or learning products.
* Prior experience managing an editorial or publishing team.
* Strong understanding of children’s content, age appropriateness, storytelling, learning and product development.
* Ability to evaluate both editorial quality and commercial potential.
* Strong visual and product sensibility.
* Exposure to international publishing trends and formats would be highly valuable.
* Comfortable working across books, activity products, novelty formats and newer publishing concepts.
* Strong project\-management ability with the discipline to manage multiple publishing projects simultaneously.
* A collaborative leader who can work across Editorial, Design, Production, Sales and Marketing.
* Curious, research\-oriented and willing to challenge conventional publishing approaches.



  





  





**What Will Define Success in This Role?** 




  





 Success will not simply be measured by the number of books published.
 



  





 It will be measured by:
 



  





 Building stronger and more differentiated publishing properties.
 



 Developing products that consumers actively seek out.
 



 Improving the commercial success rate of new publishing projects.
 



 Creating scalable series and intellectual properties.
 



 Improving publishing quality and speed.
 



 Building a strong, accountable and creative editorial team.
 



 Helping Pegasus become a trusted partner for children’s reading, learning and screen\-free engagement.
 



 About Pegasus
 



  





 Pegasus is part of the B. Jain Group, a publishing group with a legacy dating back to 1966\.
 



 Over the years, Pegasus has grown into one of India’s significant children’s publishing brands, with products distributed across India and international markets.
 



 Today, our ambition goes beyond publishing individual books.
 



 We are building Pegasus around a larger purpose — helping children Read, Learn, Create, Play, Solve and grow through meaningful screen\-free experiences.
 



 If you have spent your career creating great publishing products and believe children’s publishing needs to combine creativity, consumer understanding and commercial thinking, we would love to hear from you.
 



 I would make one important change versus a conventional publishing JD: don’t over\-emphasise “10–15 years publishing experience” and degrees at the top. You could end up attracting traditional editorial managers who are very good at producing books but weak at deciding what should be published. For where Pegasus is headed, product judgement \+ consumer understanding \+ publishing discipline matter more.

**Product Manager — Digital Platform \& Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4 years in product management
 



**Team:** 
 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE)
 



  





**Who we are** 




 Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world\-class multi\-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City \& Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
 



 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager who can take a messy, real\-world problem — on a hospital floor, at a billing counter, or in a patient's phone — define it sharply, and ship products that measurably improve how patients experience care and how clinicians deliver it.
 



 You will be one of the early product managers in DPE, working closely with the Chief Digital Officer, engineering leadership and some of India's most eminent clinicians. The role combines the product craft of a top internet company with the rigour healthcare demands: here, a missed requirement is not just a bug — it can affect a patient's care.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care, from finding the right doctor and booking a visit to diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads, and gives them time back for patient care.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable capabilities such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — products built around how people naturally interact: speaking instead of typing, tapping instead of filling forms, and intelligence that assists at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow, designed for how care is delivered today.
* **Intelligence across the hospital** 
 — AI for triage, clinical decision support, clinical documentation, and planning of beds, operating theatres and resources.
* **Care beyond the hospital walls** 
 — home care, remote monitoring and connected care that extend Medanta's expertise to wherever patients are.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap and end\-to\-end lifecycle for one or more products or platforms — from discovery through launch, adoption and scale.
* Lead product discovery on the ground: spend time with clinicians, nurses, front\-office teams and patients to deeply understand workflows and pain points before defining what to build.
* Partner with senior doctors and business leaders to understand the need behind every request, evaluate the proposed solution alongside alternatives, and align on the approach that best serves patients and the organization.
* Take a platform\-first view: identify common patterns across products and requests, and build reusable capabilities that scale across the network.
* Translate problems into clear PRDs, user journeys and acceptance criteria; work with design and engineering to deliver intuitive voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences.
* Use AI tools to accelerate product work — research, specifications, prototyping and analysis.
* Ensure launches are complete for critical workflows, so users can rely on new products fully from day one.
* Embed patient safety, data privacy and regulatory requirements (such as NABH, JCI, DPDP and ABDM) into product design from the start.
* Drive adoption with operations, nursing and clinical teams, and treat user feedback as a core input to the roadmap.
* Define clear success metrics for every product — adoption, turnaround time, conversion, clinician time saved, patient outcomes — and use them to continuously improve the product through regular reviews, experimentation and iteration.
* Prioritize with clarity and communicate trade\-offs, progress and impact transparently to stakeholders and leadership.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 3–4 years of product management experience in internet product companies (e.g., e\-commerce, fintech, healthtech, edtech, marketplaces or consumer platforms).
* A track record of shipping and scaling products with large user bases and measurable business or user impact.
* Strong first\-principles problem definition, and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Data\-driven decision making — comfortable with funnels, analytics tools, SQL and experimentation.
* Platform thinking — the ability to spot common patterns across problems and design reusable capabilities rather than one\-off features.
* Enough technical depth to engage engineers on architecture, APIs, integrations and data trade\-offs.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to partner with and build alignment among senior, expert stakeholders.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools in day\-to\-day product work.
* Willingness to spend meaningful time in hospital environments, observing workflows and working alongside clinical and operations teams.
* High ownership, a bias for both rigour and speed, strong user\-experience instincts, and genuine empathy for end users.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on software development experience before moving into product management.
* Experience building platform or API products — payments, subscriptions, integrations or developer\-facing capabilities.
* Experience with voice or conversational interfaces, AI/LLM\-based products, or complex, workflow\-heavy systems (e.g., ERP, supply chain, fulfilment or clinical systems).
* Exposure to healthcare, diagnostics or other regulated domains (not mandatory — strong product fundamentals matter more than domain background).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. from a top\-tier institution (IITs, NITs, BITS, IIITs or equivalent).
* MBA from a top\-tier institution (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS or equivalent) preferred.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* A rare chance to build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians and learn how world\-class care is delivered.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* Direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership, who are closely involved in building this team.
* Help shape how product management is practised in a newly built product organization, and grow with it.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

**Requirements**

* 10\+ years of software development experience on Product Development (on C\# .Net \& SQL – experience in Azure is a plus), with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team
* Experience contributing to cross\-team initiatives, coordinating with other team leads and team members (both remote and in\-person)
* Comfortable with working in high\-demand set\-up and ability to prioritize execution, hands\-on mentality
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
* Experience partnering with product and user experience teams
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top\-10 vulnerabilities \& remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
* Strong data\-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
* A pragmatic, outcome\-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
* A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
* Technical background is a plus \- experience in Docker, Kafka, DataBricks, ADO pipelines or Azure services (like AKS, Redis, Keyvault, EventHub, ServiceBus, SQL MI etc)
* Domain knowledge in end\-user computing and/or DEX is a plus
* Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages are a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Product Owner
description:

The role ensures that HR technology is aligned with business objectives, supports efficient and user\-friendly People processes, and delivers a seamless experience for employees and HR professionals. It also provides oversight of the People technology ecosystem, including SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Intelligence platforms, and other connected systems, while driving innovation, compliance, and operational excellence.
 



 Reporting to the People Experience and Insight pillar, the role is a key contributor to the organisation’s HRIS and People technology strategy. Working closely with Digital \& Technology teams and external partners, the role focuses on embedding transformational ways of working through technology, optimizing system processes, and delivering scalable, sustainable solutions that enhance employee experience and business outcomes.
 



  





**Main responsibilities**




 This role provides strategic leadership for the British Council’s People Technology landscape, ensuring HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Intelligence platforms, and connected tools are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business priorities. title: Lead System Requirements Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
   

  

 Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous\-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Title: Subject Matter Expert** 




**Location \- Noida** 




  





**About Paytm Group:** 
 Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid \- Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.
 



**About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):** 
 PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm’s B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm’s PA PG business in the Indian merchants.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 We are looking for highly driven and customer\-focused professionals to join our Enterprise Payments team as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role requires working closely with Sales, Product, and Business teams to drive merchant acquisition, solution consulting, and adoption of Paytm’s payment products. The SME will play a critical role in enabling enterprise sales by providing deep domain expertise in card payments, payment workflows, and digital payment solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex payment solutions into business value for enterprise merchants.
 



  





**Expectations / Requirements :** 




 ● Partner closely with enterprise sales teams to drive merchant acquisition and revenue growth by acting as a payments domain expert during client discussions and solution presentations.
 



 ● Engage with CXOs, payment heads, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand merchant requirements and recommend suitable payment solutions.
 



 ● Support sales teams in pitching Paytm’s payment suite including Card Payments, Tokenisation, International Card Payments, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway solutions, UPI, and value\-added payment products.
 



 ● Act as a trusted advisor for merchants by providing consultative solutioning aligned with their business models, payment flows, and customer experience goals.
 



 ● Work with Product and Technology teams to identify market requirements, product gaps, and opportunities for enhancing payment offerings.
 



 ● Contribute towards product ideation, competitive benchmarking, and feedback\-driven improvements to strengthen Paytm’s market positioning.
 



 ● Drive product adoption and merchant penetration by enabling successful onboarding, training, and solution implementation.
 



 ● Lead merchant\-facing discussions for new product launches, feature enhancements, and payment optimization initiatives.
 



 ● Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), use cases, and workflow recommendations to support product enhancements and digital\-first customer journeys.
 



 ● Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Product, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Technology to ensure seamless execution and faster resolution of merchant requirements.
 



 ● Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies within the payments and fintech ecosystem to strengthen sales strategy and customer engagement.
 



  





**Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed in this role :** 




 ● Minimum 5 years of experience in Payments, Fintech, Product Consulting, Solution Engineering, or Business Product Management with strong exposure to enterprise sales.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the card payments ecosystem including Card Processing, Tokenisation, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway flows, International Card Payments, and online/offline payment solutions.
 



 ● Ability to drive consultative and solution\-led sales conversations with enterprise merchants and senior stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex payment concepts for business audiences.
 



 ● Experience working closely with cross\-functional teams and driving alignment between Sales, Product, and Technology teams.
 



 ● Proven ability to support GTM initiatives, product adoption strategies, and customer success programs.
 



 ● Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, customer insights, and market intelligence to influence business decisions.
 



 ● A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic fintech environment.
 



 ● Prior experience in fintech, payment gateways, banking, consulting, or enterprise solutioning roles will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why join us:** 
 We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and how it will always be.
 



**Compensation:** 
 If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn\+ registered users, 21 mn\+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers \& merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

**Description:** 
 In this role, You'll Drive transformation across Rights \& Royalties operations by leveraging business analysis, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, controls, and decision\-making. **The Role** 



  

  


 We are seeking a high\-impact Business Analyst / Data Analyst (3–4 years’ experience) to join the Rights \& Royalties Transformation Group. This role blends business analysis, analytics, and workflow automation to improve royalty accuracy, cycle times, controls, and decision visibility. The ideal candidate is fast, agile, and execution\-focused, able to grasp business fundamentals quickly, translate them into data and process requirements, and deliver measurable operational outcomes through dashboards, automation, and standardisation. Royalties domain experience is a strong advantage (rights, licensing, royalty calculations, statements, author/vendor payments, deductions, reserves, contractual terms).

* Drive automation and simplification of recurring operational activities (exceptions, validations, reconciliations, reporting packs).
  

  
* Reduce rework, disputes, and leakage risks through improved data quality and process controls.

* Understanding of royalty lifecycle (preferred).
  

  
* Basic scripting (Python) or familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts, dbt, or data quality tooling (preferred).

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science / IT / Data Analytics or Finance / Accounting / Commerce.

 Skills, Experience \& Expertise

 Strong understanding of data analytics
 



 Ability to drive alignment across teams and lead through influence in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 A strong advocate for customer\-centric design and data\-driven decision\-making.
 



  





**Eligibility**

 MBA/BTech from a premier institute

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to own our Jobs platform and take its capabilities to the next level. Your responsibilities would span the entire pipeline from ingestion, cleansing, and indexing of jobs as they come in; through searching and matching for both users in real\-time and offline notifications; to providing front\-end product interfaces to our web property product managers. All of this needs to happen at scale across our ecosystem of many millions of jobs and job seekers.
   

  

 This is an interdisciplinary role emphasizing breadth and orchestration across architecture, data engineering and science, development, analytics, and product management. A technical background is desirable and we expect a firm grasp of technical capabilities and concepts. You’ll at the very least be able to ‘read API’. However, more important is the ability to work with multiple teams to come up with a mix that works \- and works well \- for the end user. Key skills here are a strong analytical bent of mind for defining key metrics/benchmarks and measuring at scale, as well as the ability to hone in on the individual job seeker and answer the right questions: is her need being met? If not, how can we improve?
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
 BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.
   

  

 Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools \& technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Work closely with North America product leadership to understand jobs product needs and use cases.
* Work closely with senior engineering management and architecture to plot the technical vision and roadmap for the platform.
* Design, implement, and support, in cooperation with other data teams and data scientists a platform to measure our jobs quality, coverage, and relevancy through manual and automatic mechanisms.
* Analyse and measure the quality and coverage of vendor feeds.
* Measure and improve our job recommendations and search capabilities.
* Work with internal teams to build dashboards which will be used by internal stakeholders (product, office of the CEO, analytics etc).
* Measure and improve jobs data quality to point out issues with jobs data/gaps with jobs data.
* Work with the data science team to build jobs evaluation ML models.
* Evaluate jobs data coverage for jobs within the BOLD system.
* Translate business requirements and develop an end to end solution.
* Design web\-scale products following best coding principles, optimized coding practices and using open source tools \& platforms.
* Proactively identify potential problems and opportunities to improve the data pipelines related to jobs data.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Experience in the jobs domain with a good understanding of jobs, job matching, jobs recommendations.
* Proven track record of taking ownership, thinking strategically, and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Possess an understanding of technology stacks and level of efforts involved in order to be able to make right decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging and influencing senior executives.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive actions.
* Engineering/ Master’s Degree from a good Institute (preferably Computer Science or related).


**EXPERIENCE\-**
* Technical Product Manager\- 10 years\+


**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**
* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**
* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**
* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)


**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**
* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In\-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick\-up and drop\-off facility


**About BOLD**
**We Transform Work Lives**
 As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.

title: Staff Project Engineering Manager
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing ASIC and IC design projects where the stakes are real, timelines are tight, and the difference between a successful tapeout and a missed window is your ability to see around corners. You know that the hardest part of delivering complex IP is not just the technical work, it is keeping cross\-functional teams aligned when R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and customers all have different definitions of "done."
   

  

 You do not manage by status reports alone. You get into the details when a SerDes PHY design hits a roadblock, understand the technical tradeoffs well enough to ask the right questions, and work with your engineers to find a path forward that does not compromise quality or schedule. You have learned that risk management is not about spreadsheets, it is about knowing which risks to escalate, which to mitigate quietly, and which conversations to have before they become problems.
   

  

 You are the kind of leader who can translate a customer's vague requirement into a concrete project scope, push back when timelines do not match reality, and still maintain trust on all sides. You care about process, but only when it makes the team faster and more effective, not for its own sake.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead SerDes PHY IP projects that power the next generation of high\-speed connectivity in everything from data centers to automotive systems. The work is technical, the teams are global, and what you deliver will ship in products that matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of high\-speed SerDes PHY IP projects from definition through tapeout and customer deployment
* Lead cross\-functional project teams including design engineers, verification engineers, and layout specialists to execute against aggressive schedules
* Partner with R\&D and Marketing to define project roadmaps, prioritize features, and align technical deliverables with market requirements
* Identify resource gaps, manage project risks, and resolve cross\-team dependencies before they block progress
* Drive process improvements across the engineering organization, implementing best practices that reduce cycle time and improve quality
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams on pre\-sales technical engagement and post\-sales issue resolution
* Deliver regular status updates to executive leadership and customers, translating technical progress into business outcomes


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Accelerate time\-to\-market for advanced SerDes IP that enables high\-speed connectivity in AI, automotive, and data center applications
* Enable customers to meet increasingly complex design requirements with proven, high\-quality IP that integrates cleanly into their SoCs
* Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner for mission\-critical semiconductor IP through consistent on\-time, on\-spec delivery
* Improve engineering efficiency across the organization by identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable processes that work across multiple projects
* Foster tighter collaboration between R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support, ensuring alignment from early concept through customer deployment
* Contribute directly to Synopsys' leadership position in high\-speed interface IP, supporting customers building the next generation of smart, connected devices
* Mentor project leads and engineers on your team, building organizational capability in technical program management and cross\-functional leadership


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's/PhD with 6\+ years
* Deep technical knowledge of IC design, ASIC development flows, and semiconductor IP integration, particularly in mixed\-signal or SerDes domains
* Proven track record leading complex engineering projects in a high\-tech environment, ideally in semiconductor IP or ASIC development
* Strong risk management and change management skills, with experience navigating technical uncertainty and scope changes without derailing schedules
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, you can explain technical tradeoffs to executives and translate customer requirements into actionable engineering plans
* Experience with SerDes PHY IP, high\-speed interface standards like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a strong plus
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools, whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to hardware development


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a project review, quickly assess whether the team is on track or at risk, and ask the two questions that get to the real issue
* When a customer escalation lands on your desk, you do not panic or deflect, you pull the right people together, get to root cause, and own the path to resolution

**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations.  Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is India’s leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved “Bharat” through technology\-enabled financial services.

Spice Money has consistently introduced industry\-first innovations such as a zero\-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI \& Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages.
 



 Operating across 95%\+ pincodes with a team of 1,000\+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high\-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India.

 This role is critical in defining the strategic direction and long\-term success of an end\-to\-end product domain. In addition to driving domain outcomes, you will lead cross\-functional squads and mentor junior product managers. Depending on organizational assignment, the role may oversee domains such as Adhikari onboarding and KYC, assisted payments, merchant acceptance, lending, insurance, growth and engagement, internal sales tools, risk/compliance platforms, or shared product infrastructure.
